commands.name: 3DALIGN
commands.summary: Aligns solids in 3D by up to three source and destination points (translation, then direction, then plane); optional scaling.

commands.name: 3DARRAY
commands.summary: Creates rectangular (rows × columns × levels) or polar 3D arrays of objects.

commands.name: 3DOSNAP
commands.summary: Sets 3D object snap modes on solids: ZVertex, ZMidpoint, ZCenter (face), ZKnot, ZPerpendicular, ZNearest, ALL, NONE.

commands.name: ABOUT
commands.summary: About Oanarina Archi Tool: version, license and credits.

commands.name: ACCESSIBILITY
commands.summary: Accessibility check: door clear widths (A11YDOORWIDTH, default 850 mm) and Ø1500 mm wheelchair turning circles in bathrooms clear of fixtures (A11YTURNING).

commands.name: ACTMANAGER
commands.summary: Lists, shows, deletes, renames, exports (.scr) or imports action macros.

commands.name: ACTPLAY
commands.summary: Plays back a recorded action macro.

commands.name: ACTRECORD
commands.summary: Starts recording an action macro (typed commands and picks); ACTSTOP saves it in the drawing.

commands.name: ACTSTOP
commands.summary: Stops recording and saves the action macro under a name (stored in the drawing).

commands.name: ADAPTIVE
commands.summary: Adaptive components driven by placement points: Place a Strut, Panel, Frame or a family using P1x…P1z, P2x… values (points typed x,y,z or picked point objects the component follows); Move a point to flex it.

commands.name: ADCENTER
commands.summary: Design Center: browses another drawing's blocks, layers, linetypes, styles and materials and adds them here.

commands.name: AGENTSETTINGS
commands.summary: Agent server settings: port, start/stop, token, auto-start.

commands.name: ALIAS
commands.summary: Defines command aliases and macros (Define/Delete/List/Global/Load/Save); ";" in a macro is Enter.

commands.name: ALIGN
commands.summary: Aligns objects with other objects using source/destination point pairs.

commands.name: ALIGNREF
commands.summary: Rotates objects about a base point so a reference direction (line or two points) aligns with a target line or angle.

commands.name: AMBIENTOCCLUSION
commands.summary: Ambient occlusion baked on the model: Intensity (0 = off … 2), Radius and Samples; shaded elevations, sections, axonometrics and perspectives (and their PDF/SVG exports) darken corners and overhangs; Report prints the average occlusion.

commands.name: ANALYTICALMODEL
commands.summary: Builds the structural analytical model (nodes, members, wall/slab panels, supports, loads) from columns, beams, walls and slabs and writes it as JSON, OpenSees Tcl, SAF (.xlsx) or an IFC4 structural analysis view (.ifc).

commands.name: ANGLEBETWEEN
commands.summary: Angle between two lines (or vertex + two points).

commands.name: ANIMATE
commands.summary: Object animation saved in the drawing: Door swings, Rotate about a pivot, Move by a vector (start time, duration, there and back); Play/Stop in 3D, List, Delete, Clear, Render a frame.

commands.name: ANNOTATIVE
commands.summary: Makes text, leaders and tables annotative (height follows CANNOSCALE) or turns it off.

commands.name: AODIALOG
commands.summary: Ambient Occlusion dialog: intensity, radius and rays per point for the 3D viewport, renders and shaded views.

commands.name: APPSELFTEST
commands.summary: Runs the app's built-in regression checks (node graph, sheet set, presets, clipboard, ribbon).

commands.name: ARC
commands.summary: Draws an arc (3 points, start-center-end, start-end-radius, center-start-angle, continue).

commands.name: ARC2PH
commands.summary: Draws an arc through two end points with a given height (sagitta); pick or type the height.

commands.name: ARC2PL
commands.summary: Draws an arc through two end points with a given arc length (longer than the chord).

commands.name: ARCTEXT
commands.summary: Places text along an arc (convex or concave side, height, offset), one character per text object, grouped.

commands.name: ARCTOCIRCLE
commands.summary: Completes arcs into full circles (keeps layer and properties).

commands.name: AREA
commands.summary: Calculates area and perimeter of points or objects (with Add/Subtract).

commands.name: AREAPLAN
commands.summary: Creates area plan boundaries (Gross, Rentable or custom schemes) and reports totals per scheme.

commands.name: AREASCHEME
commands.summary: Area schemes (GEA, GIA, NIA, DIN 277 BGF/NRF, Gross, Rentable): places associative area boundaries that follow the walls, lists schemes and reports totals.

commands.name: ARQUICKLOOK
commands.summary: AR view: exports the model as a real-scale glTF (GLB) and Previews it in the Windows 3D viewer (mixed reality) or Shares it to a phone or tablet.

commands.name: ARRAY
commands.summary: Creates copies of objects in a rectangular, polar or path pattern.

commands.name: ARRAYCLASSIC
commands.summary: Creates a non-associative (separate copies) rectangular, polar or path array.

commands.name: ARRAYEDIT
commands.summary: Edits an associative array: rows, columns, spacing, items, fill angle, rotation, alignment.

commands.name: ARRAYPATH
commands.summary: Array of objects evenly spaced along a path.

commands.name: ARRAYPOLAR
commands.summary: Polar array of objects around a center point.

commands.name: ARRAYRECT
commands.summary: Rectangular array of objects in rows and columns.

commands.name: ASK
commands.summary: Natural-language request, e.g. "draw a 4 m wall north of grid A", "add a door 900 wide in the middle of the last wall", "move the selection 2 m east": shows what was understood and asks before applying (one undo step).

commands.name: ASSEMBLY
commands.summary: Assemblies (element aggregation): Create from selected elements, Add, Remove, Disassemble, Views (isolated plan and 3D views), List.

commands.name: ASSISTANT
commands.summary: AI assistant panel: Claude or a local model (Ollama) edits the drawing with commands; bulk changes ask for confirmation; everything is undoable.

commands.name: ATTDEF
commands.summary: Defines an attribute (modes Invisible/Constant/Verify/Preset/Lock, tag, prompt, default) to include in a block.

commands.name: ATTEDIT
commands.summary: Changes attribute values of a block reference.

commands.name: ATTEXT
commands.summary: Extracts block reference attributes to a CSV file (or the command line).

commands.name: ATTSYNC
commands.summary: Updates block references with the current attribute definitions of their block.

commands.name: AUDIT
commands.summary: Checks the drawing for errors (duplicate IDs, dangling openings, missing layers/blocks) and fixes them.

commands.name: AUTOCONSTRAIN
commands.summary: Infers and applies constraints (coincident, tangent, horizontal, vertical, parallel, perpendicular) to the selected objects within tolerances.

commands.name: AUTOCONSTRAINANGLE
commands.summary: System variable AUTOCONSTRAINANGLE.

commands.name: AUTOCONSTRAINDIST
commands.summary: System variable AUTOCONSTRAINDIST.

commands.name: AUTODIMGRIDS
commands.summary: Associative dimension string across parallel grid lines (bay dimensions and overall), updated when grids move.

commands.name: AUTODIMPLAN
commands.summary: Dimensions the current level's plan automatically: exterior chains on all four sides (openings, walls, overall) on layer A-ANNO-DIMS; asks before adding them (one undo step).

commands.name: AUTODIMWALLS
commands.summary: Automatic dimension strings along wall faces through wall ends and openings, with an overall dimension.

commands.name: AUTONAMEROOMS
commands.summary: Names and numbers rooms of the current level from their fixtures (toilet, bath, bed, kitchen…), shape, windows and doors; Unnamed only or All; lists the suggestions and asks before applying (one undo step).

commands.name: AUTOSNAP
commands.summary: System variable AUTOSNAP.

commands.name: AUTOSTACK
commands.summary: Stacks typed fractions in text (1/2, 3#4, 1^2) or unstacks them.

commands.name: AXISLOCK
commands.summary: Locks point input to the UCS X or Y axis, an angle, or turns the lock Off (arrow keys while drawing).

commands.name: AXONVIEW
commands.summary: Saves a 3D axonometric view (SW / SE / NE / NW isometric, Top, or Custom azimuth/elevation) that refits to the model after every change.

commands.name: BACKVIEW
commands.summary: Sets the 3D view to back.

commands.name: BASE
commands.summary: Sets the drawing's insertion base point (INSBASE), used when it is inserted as a block.

commands.name: BATCH
commands.summary: Runs a JSON batch job file over many drawings: open/import, command lines or a script, outputs in any export format, analysis reports and save (the open drawing is not changed).

commands.name: BATCHPUBLISH
commands.summary: Publishes chosen sheets to one PDF with bookmarks (sheet number and name) and optional sheet index.

commands.name: BATTMAN
commands.summary: Edits the attribute definitions of a block (prompt, default, tag, modes, order, delete) and syncs references.

commands.name: BCFIN
commands.summary: Imports BCF 2.x topics (.bcfzip) as markups: comments, status, viewpoint camera and selection mapped to elements by IFC GlobalId.

commands.name: BCFOUT
commands.summary: Exports the markups as BCF 2.1 topics (.bcfzip) with comments, status, camera and selected elements by IFC GlobalId.

commands.name: BCFSERVER
commands.summary: Connects to a BCF API (OpenCDE) server: Connect (URL, bearer token), Projects, Pull (topics → markups with comments, cameras and selections) and Push (markups → topics, comments and viewpoints). The server URL and project are saved in the drawing (BCFSERVER, BCFPROJECT); the token is kept only for the session.

commands.name: BCLOSE
commands.summary: Closes the block editor, saving or discarding the changes.

commands.name: BCOUNT
commands.summary: Counts block references (including nested ones) in the drawing or a selection.

commands.name: BEAM
commands.summary: Draws structural beams between points, or between picked columns (Columns: top of beam at the column tops).

commands.name: BEAMSYSTEM
commands.summary: Fills a boundary with parallel beams at a spacing (direction, size or profile, top elevation).

commands.name: BEDIT
commands.summary: Opens a block definition in the block editor (only its objects are shown; new objects join the block). BCLOSE saves.

commands.name: BFLIP
commands.summary: Flips block references about their insertion point (dynamic flip parameter, state kept in the reference).

commands.name: BILLBOARD
commands.summary: Places a 2D cutout that always faces the camera in 3D and renders: Person, Tree, Shrub or an image file (PNG with transparency).

commands.name: BIMUPDATE
commands.summary: Regenerates associative content: area boundaries, automatic dimensions, associative sweeps and family instances.

commands.name: BLEND
commands.summary: Creates a tangent (or smooth) spline joining the ends of two open curves.

commands.name: BLOCK
commands.summary: Creates a block definition from selected objects.

commands.name: BLOCKBASE
commands.summary: Changes a block definition's base point; references stay where they are.

commands.name: BLOCKLIBRARY
commands.summary: Browses a folder of drawings as a block library: List, Search, Insert (files and the blocks inside them).

commands.name: BLOCKPALETTE
commands.summary: Block library panel: library folders with thumbnails, search, favourites and recents; drag blocks onto the drawing.

commands.name: BLOCKREPLACE
commands.summary: Replaces all references of one block with another (keeps attributes with matching tags).

commands.name: BOQ
commands.summary: Bill of quantities: takeoff items priced with unit rates (UNITPRICE rates or a JSON table), numbered by trade with subtotals, contingency (BOQCONTINGENCY %) and VAT (BOQVAT %); CSV or XLSX.

commands.name: BOTTOMVIEW
commands.summary: Sets the 3D view to bottom.

commands.name: BOUNDARY
commands.summary: Creates closed polylines from the area enclosed around a picked point.

commands.name: BOUNDINGBOX
commands.summary: Draws the rectangle bounding the selected objects.

commands.name: BOX
commands.summary: Creates a 3D solid box (on the face under the first corner when DUCS is on).

commands.name: BPARAMETER
commands.summary: Adds dynamic parameters to a block: Stretch (a length that stretches the objects in a frame) or Array (a count repeating objects); List, Delete.

commands.name: BRACE
commands.summary: Places a diagonal brace between two plan points at a bottom and a top elevation (profile, default CHS).

commands.name: BREAK
commands.summary: Breaks an object between two points.

commands.name: BREAKALL
commands.summary: Breaks the selected objects at every intersection with each other.

commands.name: BREAKATPOINT
commands.summary: Breaks an object into two at a single point.

commands.name: BREAKLINE
commands.summary: Draws a break line with a zig-zag symbol (size, extension).

commands.name: BREPIN
commands.summary: Imports an OpenCASCADE BREP file (FreeCAD .brep/.brp) as mesh solids: stored triangulations are used, other faces are triangulated from their edges.

commands.name: BREPOUT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as an OpenCASCADE BREP file (shells of planar faces, millimetres) for FreeCAD, Salome and other OCCT tools.

commands.name: BSAVE
commands.summary: Saves the block editor content into the block definition.

commands.name: BSDD
commands.summary: buildingSMART Data Dictionary: Search classes online (or Load a saved bSDD JSON), Assign a class and its properties to elements, add a view Filter on a class, List assigned classes.

commands.name: BTABLE
commands.summary: Block properties table: named sets of dynamic parameter values (Add/Delete/List) applied to references by name (Apply).

commands.name: BUILDING
commands.summary: Quick massing: a rectangle becomes walls, floor slabs and a roof on one or more storeys; Mass turns 3D solids (conceptual masses) into mass floors or walls/floors/roofs by face.

commands.name: BUILDINGPAD
commands.summary: Levels a toposurface inside a boundary to a pad elevation (cut and fill).

commands.name: BVSTATE
commands.summary: Dynamic block visibility states: New, Set (on references), Hide/Show objects in a state, List, Delete, Rename.

commands.name: CABLETRAY
commands.summary: Draws cable trays (open U-channel with rungs in plan) along points.

commands.name: CAL
commands.summary: Evaluates an arithmetic expression (+ - * / ^, sqrt, sin, cos, pi…).

commands.name: CALLOUT
commands.summary: Draws a callout (boundary, leader and numbered bubble) in plan and places the enlarged detail view it refers to.

commands.name: CAMERA
commands.summary: Restores a saved 3D camera (or lists them).

commands.name: CAMERAPATHEDIT
commands.summary: Camera path editor: keys from the 3D view or saved cameras at times, timeline scrubbing and playback, video export.

commands.name: CAMERAVIEW
commands.summary: Places a camera object (eye, target, heights, lens) saved as a perspective 3D view; cameras show in plan with their field of view.

commands.name: CANNOSCALE
commands.summary: System variable CANNOSCALE.

commands.name: CARBON
commands.summary: Embodied carbon (A1–A3, kgCO2e) of the model's materials from takeoff volumes, densities and carbon factors (CARBON:/DENSITY: overrides); optional CSV.

commands.name: CECOLOR
commands.summary: System variable CECOLOR.

commands.name: CEILING
commands.summary: Creates a ceiling from points, a closed object or the walls around a point.

commands.name: CELTYPE
commands.summary: System variable CELTYPE.

commands.name: CELWEIGHT
commands.summary: System variable CELWEIGHT.

commands.name: CENTEREXE
commands.summary: System variable CENTEREXE.

commands.name: CENTERLINE
commands.summary: Creates an associative centre line between two lines.

commands.name: CENTERMARK
commands.summary: Adds associative centre marks to circles and arcs.

commands.name: CENTRAL
commands.summary: Work sharing with a central model: Create (make this drawing the central file), Local (open a local copy of a central file), Sync (synchronise with central, optionally keeping borrowed elements), Borrow / Relinquish selected elements, Owners (who owns what), Permissions (signed access policy: viewer/editor/admin roles and protected layers, enforced on Sync; refused changes are saved beside the local copy).

commands.name: CETRANSPARENCY
commands.summary: System variable CETRANSPARENCY.

commands.name: CFDEXPORT
commands.summary: Writes an OpenFOAM wind-study case (simpleFoam, atmospheric boundary layer inlet, snappyHexMesh around the building, pedestrian-level sampling) for the given wind speed and direction.

commands.name: CHAMFER
commands.summary: Bevels the corner between two lines (distance or length/angle method).

commands.name: CHAMFERA
commands.summary: System variable CHAMFERA.

commands.name: CHAMFERB
commands.summary: System variable CHAMFERB.

commands.name: CHAMFEREDGE
commands.summary: Bevels the edges of boxes and extruded solids (all, vertical, top or bottom edges).

commands.name: CHECKMODEL
commands.summary: Checks the model: walls without height, openings wider than or outside their host, overlapping/duplicate walls and rooms, unnamed or duplicate rooms, missing levels.

commands.name: CHPROP
commands.summary: Changes color, layer, linetype, lineweight or material of objects.

commands.name: CHSPACE
commands.summary: Moves objects between model space and a layout's paper space through a viewport, keeping their size on the sheet.

commands.name: CIRCLE
commands.summary: Draws a circle (center/radius, diameter, 2P, 3P, tangent-tangent-radius, tangent-tangent-tangent).

commands.name: CIRCLE2PR
commands.summary: Draws a circle through two points with a given radius (pick the side of the centre).

commands.name: CIRCLETPP
commands.summary: Draws a circle tangent to one object through two points.

commands.name: CIRCLETTP
commands.summary: Draws a circle tangent to two objects through one point.

commands.name: CIRCLETTT
commands.summary: Draws a circle tangent to three objects (lines, circles, arcs).

commands.name: CIRCUIT
commands.summary: Electrical circuits: Create (devices on a panel circuit with description and breaker), Remove devices, Show wiring home runs, List circuits.

commands.name: CITYJSONIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports a CityJSON city model (buildings, terrain, roads … at their highest LoD) as mesh solids per city object with attributes.

commands.name: CLASHDETECT
commands.summary: Finds hard clashes between elements and 3D solids (touching and hosted/joined elements are ignored); lists, selects and zooms.

commands.name: CLASHMANAGE
commands.summary: Manages clash results kept in the drawing: Run (detect; disappeared clashes become resolved), List, Group (Type/Level/Proximity), Status, Assign, Zoom to a clash (selects both elements), Csv export.

commands.name: CLASSIFY
commands.summary: Classification codes: Auto-classify by element kind (Uniformat II, NL-SfB), Set a code in any system (Uniclass 2015, OmniClass…), List, Clear.

commands.name: CLAYER
commands.summary: System variable CLAYER.

commands.name: CLEANSCREENOFF
commands.summary: Restores the ribbon and panels after CLEANSCREENON.

commands.name: CLEANSCREENON
commands.summary: Clean screen: hides the ribbon and panels (Ctrl+0 toggles).

commands.name: CLEVEL
commands.summary: System variable CLEVEL.

commands.name: CLIPPLANES
commands.summary: Clipping plane panel in the 3D view: horizontal or vertical cut, live offset slider, flip, remove.

commands.name: CLIPPOLY
commands.summary: Clips the selected curves with a closed boundary, keeping the parts Inside or Outside.

commands.name: CLOSE
commands.summary: Closes the current drawing.

commands.name: CMDLINEOPTIONS
commands.summary: Command line appearance: text Size, history Lines shown, background Opacity; Float it over the canvas or Dock it at the bottom.

commands.name: COBIEOUT
commands.summary: Exports a COBie 2.4 spreadsheet (.xlsx): contact, facility, floors, spaces, types, components (doors, windows, equipment) and attributes.

commands.name: CODECHECK
commands.summary: Checks rooms (area, height, width, window-to-floor ratio), stairs (riser, tread, 2R+T, width, flight), ramps and doors against JSON code rules (CODERULES or a file); lists, selects and zooms.

commands.name: CODERULES
commands.summary: Stores code rules in the drawing from a JSON file (Load), writes the current rules to a file (Save) or restores the defaults.

commands.name: COEDIT
commands.summary: Co-editing through a shared folder: Join (folder, your name), Sync (send your edits, receive the others'; also after each command with AUTOSYNC), Status, Leave. Edits of different objects merge; concurrent edits of one object keep the latest and are reported.

commands.name: COLOR
commands.summary: Sets the color for new objects (CECOLOR).

commands.name: COLORBLINDCHECK
commands.summary: Checks layer colours for colour-blind safety (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia; CIEDE2000) against the background; Fix re-colours the conflicting layers from the Okabe–Ito palette.

commands.name: COLORBOOK
commands.summary: Colour books (open palettes): list books and colours, apply a colour to objects or set it current (Book$Colour).

commands.name: COLORFILL
commands.summary: Colours rooms/areas by a parameter (name, department, area range, level, any property) and places a colour legend.

commands.name: COLUMN
commands.summary: Places structural columns (rectangular or round); Grids places one at every grid intersection, hosted so it follows the grids.

commands.name: COMMANDS
commands.summary: Lists every command with its aliases and summary.

commands.name: COMMANDSEARCH
commands.summary: Opens the command search palette (Ctrl+K).

commands.name: COMPARE
commands.summary: Compares the drawing with another version (.archi, .dxf, .ifc…) by object id and geometry: added, removed and modified objects; optional colour-coded overlay file (green added, red removed, yellow modified) and CSV report.

commands.name: COMPAREPANEL
commands.summary: Compares with another version and draws the differences over the plan (added green, removed red, modified yellow).

commands.name: COMPONENT
commands.summary: Places parametric furniture, fixtures, casework, cars and plants from the library (or a custom box); size flexes the family.

commands.name: COMPONENTTOBIM
commands.summary: Converts component / group instances or solids into schedulable BIM component elements (category and name).

commands.name: CONDUIT
commands.summary: Draws electrical conduit along points with elbows.

commands.name: CONE
commands.summary: Creates a 3D solid cone or frustum.

commands.name: CONNECTCLAUDE
commands.summary: Explains how to connect Claude (archi-engine --mcp or the local agent server).

commands.name: CONSTRAINTBAR
commands.summary: Shows or hides constraint glyphs next to constrained objects in the plan [Show/Hide/Toggle] (CONSTRAINTBAR variable).

commands.name: CONSTRAINTINFER
commands.summary: System variable CONSTRAINTINFER.

commands.name: CONSTRAINTLIST
commands.summary: Lists the constraints (of the selected objects, or all) with their values and the remaining degrees of freedom.

commands.name: CONTOURS
commands.summary: Sets the contour interval and major-line spacing of toposurfaces (0 = hide contours).

commands.name: CONVERTTOPLINE
commands.summary: Converts lines, arcs, circles, ellipses and splines to polylines (curves sampled within a tolerance).

commands.name: CONVTOMESH
commands.summary: Converts parametric solids (box, cylinder, extrusion, revolve…) into editable triangle meshes.

commands.name: CONVTOSOLID
commands.summary: Converts closed meshes into solids (cleaned and oriented); open meshes are refused (MESHREPAIR can close them).

commands.name: COPY
commands.summary: Copies objects (multiple copies, or a linear array).

commands.name: COPYBASE
commands.summary: Copies objects to the clipboard with a base point.

commands.name: COPYCLIP
commands.summary: Copies objects to the clipboard.

commands.name: COPYMONITOR
commands.summary: Copy/monitor levels and grids from a linked model: Copy, Check (coordination review), Update, Release.

commands.name: COPYPICTURE
commands.summary: Copies the selected objects (or the whole drawing) to the clipboard as a vector PDF and a PNG picture for other apps.

commands.name: COPYTOLEVEL
commands.summary: Copies selected building elements to other levels, aligned in plan (hosted doors and windows follow their walls).

commands.name: CORNERWINDOW
commands.summary: Corner window wrapping the corner of two walls: widths along each wall from the corner, height and sill; the walls are cut through the corner and the glazing meets at a slim post.

commands.name: COSTESTIMATE
commands.summary: Cost estimate from the takeoff and unit rates (UNITPRICE drawing rates or a JSON table); optional CSV.

commands.name: COUNT
commands.summary: Counts objects by type, block and element type (selection or whole drawing).

commands.name: CRASHREPORTS
commands.summary: Opt-in crash reports: On, Off, Status, Show the saved reports (reviewed and sent only by you), Clear.

commands.name: CSGTREE
commands.summary: BRL-CAD style combination: 'u #1 - #2 + #3 u #4' (u union, - subtract, + intersect); the result regenerates when a member changes. List / Edit existing trees.

commands.name: CUI
commands.summary: Customizes the ribbon: Dialog, Add a panel of commands to a tab, Remove, Hide/Show a built-in panel, List, Export/Import a customisation file, Reset.

commands.name: CURSORSIZE
commands.summary: Sets the crosshair size as a percentage of the view (1–100).

commands.name: CURTAINSYSTEM
commands.summary: Curtain system by face: curtain walls on every vertical face of mass solids (grid spacing and mullion size).

commands.name: CURTAINWALL
commands.summary: Draws glazed curtain walls with mullion grids.

commands.name: CUSTOMIZERPANEL
commands.summary: Customizer panel: sliders, check boxes and choices for the parameters of the selected scripted object (OpenSCAD customizer comments), regenerating it on change.

commands.name: CUTBYLINE
commands.summary: Divides the selected objects where a cutting line crosses them.

commands.name: CUTCLIP
commands.summary: Moves objects to the clipboard (removes them from the drawing).

commands.name: CWGRID
commands.summary: Edits a curtain wall grid: add/remove grid lines, panels (glass, solid, spandrel, louvre, empty, door, double door), mullion types, uniform spacing.

commands.name: CYLINDER
commands.summary: Creates a 3D solid cylinder: centre, 3P, 2P or Elliptical base; height, 2Point or Axis endpoint.

commands.name: DAEOUT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as COLLADA 1.4.1 (.dae, metres, Z up, Phong materials).

commands.name: DATAEXTRACTION
commands.summary: Extracts block counts or attributes into a table in the drawing (or a CSV file).

commands.name: DATALINKUPDATE
commands.summary: Updates linked tables from their CSV/XLSX files (Update) or writes table cells back to the files (Write).

commands.name: DATUM
commands.summary: Reference geometry that follows its source: datum Plane (through a line, offset from a solid Face, or at a Level), Axis (along a line, through a circle centre or a cylinder) or Point (centre, start, end or midpoint).

commands.name: DATUMS3D
commands.summary: Shows or hides levels and grids (with heads) in the 3D view.

commands.name: DAYLIGHT
commands.summary: Average daylight factor of each room from its windows (BRE formula: T·Aw·θ·M / A(1−R²)) and the window-to-floor ratio; optional CSV.

commands.name: DAYLIGHTANNUAL
commands.summary: Climate-based daylight per room from an EPW weather file (or a clear-sky year): spatial daylight autonomy sDA300/50% and annual sunlight exposure ASE1000,250h (IES LM-83), optionally drawing the work-plane grid coloured by autonomy.

commands.name: DAYLIGHTRADIANCE
commands.summary: Climate-based daylight with Radiance: Export a Radiance study (scene, materials, room sensors, sky, run.sh for the daylight-coefficient method with an EPW) or Import its results as sDA300/50% and ASE1000,250h per room (IES LM-83).

commands.name: DBLCLKEDIT
commands.summary: Turns double-click editing of objects on or off; with an object, runs its double-click editor.

commands.name: DCALIGNED
commands.summary: Applies the aligned dimensional constraint.

commands.name: DCANGULAR
commands.summary: Applies the angular dimensional constraint.

commands.name: DCCONVERT
commands.summary: Converts dimensions into dimensional constraints.

commands.name: DCDIAMETER
commands.summary: Applies the diameter dimensional constraint.

commands.name: DCDIFFERENCE
commands.summary: Applies the difference dimensional constraint.

commands.name: DCHORIZONTAL
commands.summary: Applies the horizontal dimensional constraint.

commands.name: DCLINEAR
commands.summary: Applies the linear dimensional constraint.

commands.name: DCRADIUS
commands.summary: Applies the radius dimensional constraint.

commands.name: DCRATIO
commands.summary: Applies the ratio dimensional constraint.

commands.name: DCVERTICAL
commands.summary: Applies the vertical dimensional constraint.

commands.name: DELAY
commands.summary: Pauses a script for the given number of milliseconds (up to 32767).

commands.name: DELCONSTRAINT
commands.summary: Removes all geometric and dimensional constraints from the selected objects (or All).

commands.name: DELOBJ
commands.summary: System variable DELOBJ.

commands.name: DEMIMPORT
commands.summary: Creates a toposurface from an ESRI ASCII elevation grid (.asc, metres), subsampled to a point budget.

commands.name: DESELECT
commands.summary: Clears the selection (keeps it as the previous selection).

commands.name: DESIGNOPTION
commands.summary: Design options: new set/option, add selection to an option, edit (new elements join it), view, primary, accept primary, list.

commands.name: DETAILCOMPONENT
commands.summary: Places a 2D detail component (lumber, studs, brick, CMU, plywood, gypsum, steel sections) in the current view.

commands.name: DETAILMARK
commands.summary: Places a 2D detail bubble (number / sheet attributes) with an optional leader to the detail.

commands.name: DGNEXPORT
commands.summary: Exports the drawing's 2D objects as a MicroStation V7 .dgn file (one level per layer, master units m, resolution 0.1 mm).

commands.name: DGNIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports a MicroStation V7 .dgn file (lines, line strings, shapes, curves, circles, ellipses, arcs, text; levels become layers).

commands.name: DIM
commands.summary: Smart dimension: picks an object (line → linear/aligned, arc → radius, circle → diameter) or two points.

commands.name: DIMALIGNED
commands.summary: Creates a dimension aligned with its extension line origins.

commands.name: DIMALTUNITS
commands.summary: Shows alternate units on dimensions, e.g. mm [in]: factor, decimals, suffix (Off removes them).

commands.name: DIMANGULAR
commands.summary: Dimensions the angle between lines, of an arc, or of three points.

commands.name: DIMARC
commands.summary: Dimensions the length of an arc.

commands.name: DIMBASELINE
commands.summary: Creates dimensions from the baseline of the last dimension.

commands.name: DIMBREAK
commands.summary: Breaks dimension and extension lines where objects cross them (Auto, chosen objects or Manual gaps; associative).

commands.name: DIMCONSTRAINT
commands.summary: Applies a dimensional (driving) constraint: LInear/Horizontal/Vertical/Aligned distance, ANgular, Radius, Diameter, or Convert dimensions; values may be expressions of parameters.

commands.name: DIMCONTINUE
commands.summary: Continues a chain of dimensions from the last one.

commands.name: DIMDIAMETER
commands.summary: Dimensions the diameter of a circle or arc.

commands.name: DIMDISASSOCIATE
commands.summary: Removes associativity from selected dimensions.

commands.name: DIMDLI
commands.summary: System variable DIMDLI.

commands.name: DIMEDIT
commands.summary: Edits dimension text: Home (measured value), New text (<> = measurement).

commands.name: DIMINSPECT
commands.summary: Adds or removes an inspection frame (label | value | rate, round or angular ends) on dimensions.

commands.name: DIMJOGGED
commands.summary: Creates a jogged radius dimension for large arcs and circles (overridden centre, jog).

commands.name: DIMJOGLINE
commands.summary: Adds or removes a jog line on a linear or aligned dimension (the value is not to scale).

commands.name: DIMLAYER
commands.summary: System variable DIMLAYER.

commands.name: DIMLINEAR
commands.summary: Creates a horizontal, vertical or rotated linear dimension.

commands.name: DIMORDINATE
commands.summary: Creates X or Y ordinate dimensions from the origin (0,0).

commands.name: DIMOVERRIDE
commands.summary: Overrides dimension style variables (DIMTXT, DIMASZ, DIMDEC, DIMSCALE, DIMPOST…) on selected dimensions, or Clear overrides.

commands.name: DIMRADIUS
commands.summary: Dimensions the radius of an arc or circle.

commands.name: DIMREASSOCIATE
commands.summary: Associates dimensions with the objects at their definition points (automatic within a tolerance) so they follow edits.

commands.name: DIMREBASE
commands.summary: Changes the datum (origin) of ordinate dimensions.

commands.name: DIMREGEN
commands.summary: Updates associative dimensions, dimension breaks and overrides.

commands.name: DIMSCALE
commands.summary: System variable DIMSCALE.

commands.name: DIMSPACE
commands.summary: Evenly spaces parallel linear/aligned dimensions from a base dimension (0 aligns them).

commands.name: DIMSTYLE
commands.summary: Creates, edits, lists and sets dimension styles.

commands.name: DIMTEDIT
commands.summary: Moves the text / dimension line of a dimension to a new location.

commands.name: DIMTOLERANCE
commands.summary: Adds tolerances to dimensions: Symmetrical ±t, Deviation +u/−l, Limits (upper/lower values), Basic (boxed) or None.

commands.name: DIST
commands.summary: Measures the distance and angle between two points.

commands.name: DISTTOOBJECT
commands.summary: Shortest distance from a point to an object.

commands.name: DIVIDE
commands.summary: Places points or blocks at equal intervals along an object.

commands.name: DLINE
commands.summary: Draws double lines (two parallel polylines with end caps).

commands.name: DOCSITE
commands.summary: Writes the documentation (user guide, scripting, agent API, command reference) as an offline HTML site with search.

commands.name: DONUT
commands.summary: Draws filled rings or solid dots.

commands.name: DOOR
commands.summary: Places doors in walls (default 900×2100).

commands.name: DORMER
commands.summary: Builds a dormer on a sloped roof: front and cheek walls, a gable or shed dormer roof, and the opening in the main roof.

commands.name: DRAFTINGVIEW
commands.summary: Drafting views (2D only, not tied to the model): new, edit in isolation, close (store), place in the drawing, list.

commands.name: DRAWINGRECOVERY
commands.summary: Shows documents recovered from autosave after a crash.

commands.name: DRAWORDER
commands.summary: Changes the draw order of objects (front, back, above, under).

commands.name: DROPIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports files as if dropped on the canvas: images and PDFs are attached, vector/3D exchange formats merged, side by side from a point.

commands.name: DSETTINGS
commands.summary: Opens the drafting settings (snap, grid, polar, object snap).

commands.name: DUCS
commands.summary: Turns the dynamic UCS on or off: points picked over a 3D solid land on the face under the cursor.

commands.name: DUCT
commands.summary: Draws rectangular ducts along points with flanged bends.

commands.name: DVIEW
commands.summary: Rotates (twists) the 2D plan display; model coordinates are unchanged. DVIEW TWist 30, DVIEW Off.

commands.name: DWFIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports the sheets of a DWFx file (XPS paths, colours, line weights and text; one sheet after the other) as drawing objects.

commands.name: DWGCONVERTER
commands.summary: Shows or sets the DWG converter used by DWGIN/DWGOUT (path to ODAFileConverter or dwg2dxf; stored in the drawing).

commands.name: DWGIN
commands.summary: Imports a DWG drawing through an installed converter (ODA File Converter or LibreDWG); explains how to get one if none is installed.

commands.name: DWGOUT
commands.summary: Writes a DWG file (DXF converted by the installed ODA File Converter or LibreDWG).

commands.name: DXFOUTVERSION
commands.summary: Writes an ASCII DXF of a chosen version: R12, R2000, R2004, R2007, R2010, R2013 or R2018 (AC1032, UTF-8 text).

commands.name: DXFR12OUT
commands.summary: Writes a DXF R12 (AC1009) file for older CAD/CAM software (splines, ellipses, hatches and MText are converted).

commands.name: DYNMODE
commands.summary: System variable DYNMODE.

commands.name: DYNPROP
commands.summary: Sets dynamic parameter values of block references (stretch lengths, array counts).

commands.name: E57IN
commands.summary: Imports an ASTM E57 point cloud (all scans, poses applied, colour and intensity) as points.

commands.name: E57OUT
commands.summary: Exports the drawing's points (with their z, colour and intensity) as an ASTM E57 point cloud.

commands.name: EDGESURF
commands.summary: Coons patch mesh bounded by four edge curves that touch end to end (SURFTAB1 × SURFTAB2).

commands.name: EGRESS
commands.summary: Egress check: longest walking distance from each room to the nearest exit (exterior or exit=1 doors, stairs on upper levels) around walls and columns, against the limit (EGRESSMAX, m). Draws the routes on EGRESS-ROUTES.

commands.name: ELEVATIONMARK
commands.summary: Places a 2D elevation marker (bubble with a pointer in the view direction; 4 for an interior elevation set).

commands.name: ELEVATOR
commands.summary: Places an elevator: car, shaft walls up to a top level and a shaft opening through the floors.

commands.name: ELLIPSE
commands.summary: Draws an ellipse or elliptical arc.

commands.name: ELLIPSE4P
commands.summary: Draws an ellipse through four points with its axes at a given angle (default 0).

commands.name: ELLIPSEC3P
commands.summary: Draws an ellipse from its centre and three points on the curve.

commands.name: ELLIPSEFOCI
commands.summary: Draws an ellipse from its two foci and a point on the curve.

commands.name: ELLIPSEQUAD
commands.summary: Draws the largest ellipse inscribed in a quadrilateral (tangent to its four sides): four corners, a 4-sided closed polyline, or four lines.

commands.name: ENERGYBALANCE
commands.summary: Seasonal heating energy balance: losses from degree days (latitude table or HDD), solar gains per window orientation, internal gains, utilisation factor; optional CSV.

commands.name: ENERGYPLUS
commands.summary: EnergyPlus simulation: Export an IDF (rooms as zones, envelope surfaces, windows, layered constructions, ideal-loads HVAC, location) or Run an installed EnergyPlus on it with an EPW weather file: site energy, EUI, end uses, unmet hours and per-room heating/cooling energy and peak loads (written to the rooms).

commands.name: EQDIM
commands.summary: Equality dimensions: a chain of EQ dimensions that keeps three or more objects equally spaced (Create/Toggle EQ-value/Remove).

commands.name: ERASE
commands.summary: Removes objects from the drawing.

commands.name: ESCALATOR
commands.summary: Places an escalator from its bottom comb in a travel direction up to the level above (30°/35°, step width 600/800/1000), checks EN 115 rise/inclination/speed rules and cuts the upper floor; Check re-validates existing escalators.

commands.name: ETRANSMIT
commands.summary: Packs the drawing with its referenced images, material textures and external references (paths rewritten) and a transmittal report into a ZIP.

commands.name: EXCHANGECHECK
commands.summary: Checks the gbXML or COBie export (or a given file) against the schema's required elements, enumerations and references.

commands.name: EXPLODE
commands.summary: Breaks compound objects (polylines, blocks, hatches, dimensions) into their parts.

commands.name: EXPORT
commands.summary: Exports the drawing (PDF, DXF, SVG, OBJ, STL, GLB, IFC, CSV, PNG).

commands.name: EXPORT3MF
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as a 3MF package (millimetres, one object per element).

commands.name: EXPORTCOMMANDS
commands.summary: Exports the command reference (every registered command: name, aliases, category, summary, where it is in the UI) as Markdown or CSV.

commands.name: EXPORTPDF
commands.summary: Vector PDF with one PDF layer (OCG) per drawing layer, searchable text and hyperlinks: current sheet, model or all sheets, at true scale.

commands.name: EXPORTSETTINGS
commands.summary: Exports all preferences (theme, shortcuts, toolbar, workspaces, snippets…) to a settings file for another computer.

commands.name: EXPRESSION
commands.summary: Binds a property of selected objects to an expression over their own properties, other objects (id12.height, Name.length) and global parameters; Clear removes it; List shows them.

commands.name: EXTEND
commands.summary: Extends objects to meet boundary edges (all objects by default).

commands.name: EXTENDBY
commands.summary: Extends (positive) or trims (negative) curves by an amount at the picked end: lines, arcs, polylines, ellipses, splines.

commands.name: EXTRUDE
commands.summary: Extrudes closed 2D objects into 3D solids: height, Direction (oblique), Path, Taper angle, Both sides (symmetric).

commands.name: FAMILY
commands.summary: Family editor: new family, parameters and formulas, forms (box, cylinder, extrusion, sweep, revolve, void, nested, arrays), types, place instances, set instance values, flex, door/window builder, assign to openings.

commands.name: FAMILYLOCK
commands.summary: Family constraints: Lock a reference plane to a parameter (dimension label), EQ planes equally spaced, Plane (add a reference plane).

commands.name: FAMILYPANEL
commands.summary: Family Editor panel: families list, parameters and formulas, forms, types table, reference planes, profiles, live 3D preview and flex; Apply is one undo step.

commands.name: FIELD
commands.summary: Inserts text containing a field (area, length, property, variable, count, date) that updates automatically.

commands.name: FILEMETADATA
commands.summary: Lists the Spotlight metadata of the drawing or a file (title, authors, layers, levels, rooms, searchable text).

commands.name: FILETAB
commands.summary: Shows the file tab bar with one tab per open drawing.

commands.name: FILETABCLOSE
commands.summary: Hides the file tab bar.

commands.name: FILEVERSIONS
commands.summary: Versions of the saved file (every save keeps one): Browse window, List, Restore a version, Open a copy, Save a version now, Keep count.

commands.name: FILLEDREGION
commands.summary: View-specific filled region on the current level: solid colour or a drafting / model pattern, with optional boundary lines; associative to its boundary.

commands.name: FILLET
commands.summary: Rounds the corner between two objects (radius 0 = sharp corner).

commands.name: FILLETEDGE
commands.summary: Rounds the edges of boxes and extruded solids (all, vertical, top or bottom edges).

commands.name: FILLETRAD
commands.summary: System variable FILLETRAD.

commands.name: FILTER
commands.summary: Selects objects matching a filter expression (type=circle & radius>50 | layer=A-*); filters can be saved by name.

commands.name: FIND
commands.summary: Finds (and optionally replaces) text in texts, leaders, dimensions, tables and attributes.

commands.name: FIRECOMPARTMENTS
commands.summary: Fire compartments: room areas grouped by prop fireCompartment (else per level) against FIREMAXAREA (doubled with FIRESPRINKLERS=1), and walls between compartments below FIRERATINGREQ minutes; selects failing walls.

commands.name: FLATTEN
commands.summary: Converts objects to flat 2D geometry at elevation 0 (3D solids become their plan outlines).

commands.name: FLOATPANEL
commands.summary: Floats a panel (Properties, Layers, Levels, Browser, Materials, Tools, Sheets, History) in its own window.

commands.name: FLOORFINISH
commands.summary: Places a floor finish layer in rooms (material, thickness, tile pattern in plan).

commands.name: FLOORPATTERN
commands.summary: Shows the surface pattern of floor materials in plan: select slabs (or All on the current level); Remove deletes the patterns. The patterns follow slab, wall and material changes.

commands.name: FLY
commands.summary: Free flight in 3D: W A S D along the view direction, Q/E down/up, drag to look (no gravity or collisions).

commands.name: FOG
commands.summary: Fog / atmospheric haze in the 3D view and renders: On/Off, start and end distance, colour and falloff (saved in the drawing).

commands.name: FOLLOWME
commands.summary: SketchUp-style follow me: sweeps a profile along a path keeping its position relative to the path start (x = offset left of the path, y = height); associative.

commands.name: FOUNDATION
commands.summary: Creates strip footings under walls, isolated footings under columns, or pads from points.

commands.name: FOV
commands.summary: Sets the 3D camera field of view in degrees (15–120), or a Lens length in mm (35 mm equivalent).

commands.name: FRAMEANALYSIS
commands.summary: Linear static analysis of the column/beam frame (self weight + slab loads lumped to columns): displacements and support reactions.

commands.name: FRONTVIEW
commands.summary: Sets the 3D view to front.

commands.name: FULLSCREEN
commands.summary: Enters or leaves full screen for this drawing window.

commands.name: GBXMLOUT
commands.summary: Exports the energy model as gbXML 0.37: spaces, exterior/interior walls with windows and doors, roofs, floors, constructions with U-values.

commands.name: GCCOINCIDENT
commands.summary: Applies the coincident geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCCOLLINEAR
commands.summary: Applies the collinear geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCCONCENTRIC
commands.summary: Applies the concentric geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCEQUAL
commands.summary: Applies the equal geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCFIX
commands.summary: Applies the fixed geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCHORIZONTAL
commands.summary: Applies the horizontal geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCMIDPOINT
commands.summary: Applies the midpoint geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCPARALLEL
commands.summary: Applies the parallel geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCPERPENDICULAR
commands.summary: Applies the perpendicular geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCPOINTONCURVE
commands.summary: Applies the pointOnCurve geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCSYMMETRIC
commands.summary: Applies the symmetric geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCTANGENT
commands.summary: Applies the tangent geometric constraint.

commands.name: GCVERTICAL
commands.summary: Applies the vertical geometric constraint.

commands.name: GENDESIGN
commands.summary: Generative design: optimises floor layouts for a room programme and gross area with a genetic algorithm (daylight, proportions, adjacencies, orientation, compactness); lists the Pareto-optimal designs and builds the chosen one after confirmation.

commands.name: GEOJSONEXPORT
commands.summary: Exports 2D entities (selection or all) as GeoJSON in WGS84 or local metres.

commands.name: GEOJSONIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports GeoJSON features (WGS84 lon/lat are projected around the project location; projected metres are used as-is).

commands.name: GEOLOCATION
commands.summary: Project geolocation: City preset, or Set latitude, longitude, site elevation, time zone and true north (used by sun studies, energy and exports); List shows it.

commands.name: GEOMCONSTRAINT
commands.summary: Applies a geometric constraint: Horizontal, Vertical, Perpendicular, PArallel, Tangent, COincident, CONcentric, COLlinear, Symmetric, Equal, Fix, Midpoint, OnCurve.

commands.name: GFILTERS
commands.summary: Rule-based graphic overrides for drafting objects: Add/Remove/Enable/Disable/List (field layer/type/color/linetype/lineweight/property).

commands.name: GFUSE
commands.summary: General fuse: cuts overlapping solids into non-overlapping pieces (overlaps become their own solids).

commands.name: GITVERSION
commands.summary: Git versioning of the drawing as a line-per-object .archit file next to it: Commit (with message), Log, Diff two revisions (or a revision and the drawing) object by object, Checkout a revision (undoable).

commands.name: GIZMO3D
commands.summary: Shows a move (X/Y/Z arrows), rotate (ring) or uniform scale gizmo on the selection in the 3D view; drag it to transform (one undo step).

commands.name: GLOBALPARAM
commands.summary: Global parameters: New/Set a value or =formula, Bind element dimensions (wall height, thickness, opening width…) to an expression, Unbind, List, Delete; bound elements and family formulas update when a value changes.

commands.name: GRADEDREGION
commands.summary: Graded region: copies a toposurface, levels a pad to an elevation with daylighting side slopes, and reports cut and fill volumes (the existing surface is kept on a hidden layer).

commands.name: GRADIENT
commands.summary: Fills an enclosed area or selected objects with a gradient fill (linear, cylinder, spherical, curved; one or two colours).

commands.name: GRAPHICDISPLAY
commands.summary: Graphic display options of the current view: Sketchy lines (0–10), Silhouettes (line weight, 0 = off) and cast Shadows in plan; saved with the view.

commands.name: GRAPHICSTYLES
commands.summary: Graphic styles manager: line styles and their layers, lineweights by view scale, pen sets and graphic override filters in one dialog.

commands.name: GRAPHPLAYER
commands.summary: Graph player: runs a saved node graph with its exposed Number inputs (clamped to their ranges) and bakes the result; Window opens the player panel.

commands.name: GRID
commands.summary: Places structural grid lines (straight, Arc through 3 points or Multi-segment), auto-labelled 1,2,3 (vertical) and A,B,C (horizontal).

commands.name: GRIDDISPLAY
commands.summary: Shows/hides the drawing grid or sets its spacing.

commands.name: GRIDMODE
commands.summary: System variable GRIDMODE.

commands.name: GRIDSYSTEM
commands.summary: Creates a rectangular grid system from spacing lists (e.g. 3*6000 4500): numbered grids along X, lettered along Y.

commands.name: GRIDUNIT
commands.summary: System variable GRIDUNIT.

commands.name: GROOVE
commands.summary: PartDesign groove: revolves a sketch profile about an axis and subtracts it from a body (follows the sketch).

commands.name: GROUP
commands.summary: Creates and manages named groups (Create/Add/Remove/Explode/REName/List); picking a member selects the group (PICKSTYLE).

commands.name: HATCH
commands.summary: Fills an enclosed area or selected objects with a hatch pattern or solid fill.

commands.name: HATCHEDIT
commands.summary: Edits hatches: Properties (pattern, scale, angle), Color/background, Associate, DIsassociate, ADd/Remove boundaries, recreate Boundary, separate Hatches.

commands.name: HATCHGENERATEBOUNDARY
commands.summary: Creates closed polylines around selected hatches and makes the hatches associative to them.

commands.name: HATCHSETORIGIN
commands.summary: Sets the pattern origin of hatches: a point, a corner or the centre of the hatch extents, or the default (0,0).

commands.name: HATCHTOBACK
commands.summary: Sends all hatches behind other objects.

commands.name: HATCHTYPE
commands.summary: Sets hatches to Model patterns (real size, scale with the model) or Drafting patterns (fixed size on paper at the annotation scale).

commands.name: HEATLOSS
commands.summary: Design heat loss of the envelope (U·A·ΔT of exterior walls, windows, doors, roofs, ground floor) plus ventilation, and annual heating demand; optional CSV.

commands.name: HELIX
commands.summary: Draws a 2D/3D helix or spiral: base and top radius, turns, height and twist direction.

commands.name: HELP
commands.summary: Lists commands by category, or describes one command.

commands.name: HELPWINDOW
commands.summary: Opens the offline help browser (command pages, tutorials, shortcuts); F1 opens the running command's page.

commands.name: HIDEOBJECTS
commands.summary: Temporarily hides the selected objects (kept with the drawing until UNISOLATEOBJECTS).

commands.name: HISTORY
commands.summary: Command history: List (last N), Recent input values, Save/Load a history file, Clear, or run a previous line (!n).

commands.name: HISTORYPANEL
commands.summary: Shows the undo history and command history panel.

commands.name: HOLE
commands.summary: Hole features at sketch points or circles: diameter, depth or Through, Simple / Counterbore / Countersink, optional thread designation; follow their sketch.

commands.name: HPANG
commands.summary: System variable HPANG.

commands.name: HPGLOUT
commands.summary: Writes the current level's plan as HP-GL/2 (.plt) for plotters and cutters, at a plot scale.

commands.name: HPNAME
commands.summary: System variable HPNAME.

commands.name: HPSCALE
commands.summary: System variable HPSCALE.

commands.name: HULL
commands.summary: Convex hull solid of the selected solids (and points/curves at their elevation), like OpenSCAD hull().

commands.name: HYPERBOLA
commands.summary: Draws a hyperbola branch from centre, vertex, conjugate semi-axis and half-height (as a smooth polyline).

commands.name: HYPERLINK
commands.summary: Attaches a URL (web page or file) to objects; exported PDFs make them clickable. Empty removes the link.

commands.name: ID
commands.summary: Displays the coordinates of a location.

commands.name: IDSCHECK
commands.summary: Checks the model's IFC export (or an IFC file) against an Information Delivery Specification (.ids): entity, attribute, property and material requirements.

commands.name: IFCIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports an IFC (IFC2x3/IFC4) model: walls, slabs, columns, beams, doors, windows and spaces become BIM elements; other products become meshes.

commands.name: IFCMAP
commands.summary: IFC class mapping for export: Set a component category or element type to an IFC class and predefined type (e.g. Plumbing → IfcSanitaryTerminal.WASHHANDBASIN), List, Remove, Clear. Element props IfcExportAs override the table.

commands.name: IFCOPTIONS
commands.summary: IFC export settings saved in the drawing: schema (IFC2X3 Coordination View 2.0, IFC4 or IFC4X3), model view definition (ReferenceView = tessellated or DesignTransferView), base quantities (Qto_*) and georeferencing (IfcMapConversion).

commands.name: IFCVALIDATE
commands.summary: Validates an IFC file (or the model's own IFC export): syntax, schema header, references, GlobalIds, attribute counts, project/units, spatial containment.

commands.name: IFCXMLOUT
commands.summary: Exports the building model as ifcXML (IFC4, ISO 10303-28 XML encoding); a .zip or .ifczip name writes an IfcZIP holding the ifcXML.

commands.name: IFCZIPOUT
commands.summary: Exports the model as IfcZIP (compressed IFC4).

commands.name: IMAGEADJUST
commands.summary: Adjusts the brightness, contrast and fade (0–100) of images; Reset restores the defaults.

commands.name: IMAGEADJUSTDIALOG
commands.summary: Image Adjust dialog: brightness, contrast and fade of the selected raster images with a preview (exact on screen and in PDF plots).

commands.name: IMAGEATTACH
commands.summary: Places a raster image reference (path, insertion point, width, rotation).

commands.name: IMAGECLIP
commands.summary: Clips an image to a rectangular or polygonal boundary: ON/OFF, Delete, New boundary, Invert.

commands.name: IMAGEFRAME
commands.summary: Image clip frames: 0 hidden, 1 shown and plotted, 2 shown but not plotted.

commands.name: IMAGEIMPORT
commands.summary: Inserts a PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF/WebP image at its pixel aspect ratio; with a world file (.pgw/.jgw/.tfw/.wld) it is georeferenced (world units WORLDUNITMM, local origin GEOORIGIN).

commands.name: IMAGESCALE
commands.summary: Calibrates an image: pick two points on it and enter their real distance; the image is scaled about the first point.

commands.name: IMPORT
commands.summary: Imports a DXF, SVG or .archi file into the drawing.

commands.name: IMPORTFILE
commands.summary: Imports a file by extension: .archi, .dxf, .ifc, .svg, .obj, .stl, .3mf, .geojson, .csv/.txt/.xyz points.

commands.name: IMPORTSETTINGS
commands.summary: Imports preferences exported by EXPORTSETTINGS (restart to apply everything).

commands.name: IMPRINT
commands.summary: Imprints curves (lines, polylines, arcs, circles, 3D polylines) onto a planar face of a solid: the face is split along them, the solid stays closed.

commands.name: INCIRCLE
commands.summary: Draws the circle inscribed in the triangle formed by three lines.

commands.name: INPLACE
commands.summary: In-place generic model: turns solids modelled in context into a schedulable component (Create), or back into solids to edit (Edit).

commands.name: INSBASE
commands.summary: System variable INSBASE.

commands.name: INSERT
commands.summary: Inserts a block reference (scale, rotation, attributes).

commands.name: INSPECT
commands.summary: Opens the Inspector panel: every stored value of the selected objects, with ID and GUID.

commands.name: INSULATION
commands.summary: Draws the batt insulation symbol along a line at a given width (associative: stretch the line to extend it).

commands.name: INSUNITS
commands.summary: System variable INSUNITS.

commands.name: INTERFERE
commands.summary: Finds overlapping volumes between two sets of solids and can create them as new solids.

commands.name: INTERIORELEV
commands.summary: Places a 4-way interior elevation marker in a room and draws its four interior elevations (A–D).

commands.name: INTERSECT
commands.summary: Keeps only the common volume of the selected solids.

commands.name: INTERSECTFACES
commands.summary: SketchUp intersect faces: draws 3D edges (polylines) where the selected solids cut each other, or cut the rest of the Model.

commands.name: ISODRAFT
commands.summary: Isometric drafting: Orthographic (off), isoLeft, isoTop, isoRight — ortho and grid snap follow the isometric axes.

commands.name: ISOLATEOBJECTS
commands.summary: Temporarily hides every object except the selected ones (on the current level for building elements).

commands.name: ISOPLANE
commands.summary: Sets the current isometric plane: Left, Top, Right or Toggle to the next.

commands.name: ISOVIEW
commands.summary: Sets the 3D view to swiso.

commands.name: ISOVIST
commands.summary: Draws the isovist (area visible from a point at eye height, walls block, doors and openings are see-through) and reports its area.

commands.name: ISSUETRACKER
commands.summary: Issue tracker stored in the drawing: Add (linked to the selection), List, Show, Status, Assign, Priority, Comment, Zoom, Delete and Csv export.

commands.name: JOIN
commands.summary: Joins lines, arcs and polylines at their end points.

commands.name: JOURNAL
commands.summary: Change journal for crash recovery: On (record every change every n seconds to the recovery folder), Off, Now (record immediately), Status.

commands.name: JUSTIFYTEXT
commands.summary: Changes the justification of text without moving it.

commands.name: KEYBOARDNAV
commands.summary: Keyboard-only drawing: arrow keys move the crosshair at prompts (Shift ×10, Alt ÷10; Alt+arrows when idle), Enter picks, Tab selects under the crosshair; sets the step.

commands.name: KEYNOTE
commands.summary: Keynotes: define keys, assign them to elements with a keynote tag, and place a keynote legend table.

commands.name: KMLOUT
commands.summary: Exports KML or KMZ placed at the project location (GEOGRAPHICLOCATION / project latitude, longitude, north angle): extruded walls, slabs, roofs and rooms by level, linework by layer; KMZ also carries the 3D model (COLLADA).

commands.name: LANGUAGE
commands.summary: Interface language of the ribbon: Auto (Windows), English, Română, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano. Commands stay English.

commands.name: LASEREXPORT
commands.summary: Exports outlines for laser cutters / CNC as a true-size SVG in mm: joined continuous paths, red = cut, blue = engrave (layers *ENGRAV*/*SCORE*/*ETCH* or blue objects), optional model scale and kerf compensation.

commands.name: LAYCUR
commands.summary: Changes the layer of selected objects to the current layer.

commands.name: LAYDEL
commands.summary: Deletes a layer and all objects on it.

commands.name: LAYDESC
commands.summary: Sets or lists layer descriptions.

commands.name: LAYER
commands.summary: Manages layers: make, set, new, rename, on/off, freeze/thaw, lock/unlock, color, linetype, lineweight, delete.

commands.name: LAYERFILTER
commands.summary: Filters the Layers panel (A-*, ~*TEXT*, #on #used); Save/Delete/List named filters kept in the drawing.

commands.name: LAYERNOTIFY
commands.summary: Notifies when unreconciled new layers appear (On/Off) or lists them.

commands.name: LAYERP
commands.summary: Undoes the last change to layer settings (on/off, freeze, lock, color, current layer…) without undoing drawing edits.

commands.name: LAYERSTATE
commands.summary: Layer states: Dialog, or ?/Save/Restore/Delete/Import/Export/Rename on the command line (saved in the drawing).

commands.name: LAYFILTER
commands.summary: Named layer filters: New property filter (name=A-* on=yes color=1 used=no…), Group filter, Invert, Delete, List, Select, Current.

commands.name: LAYFRZ
commands.summary: Freezes the layer of each selected object.

commands.name: LAYISO
commands.summary: Isolates the layers of selected objects (turns the other layers off or locks them).

commands.name: LAYLCK
commands.summary: Locks the layer of each selected object.

commands.name: LAYMCUR
commands.summary: Makes the layer of a selected object current.

commands.name: LAYMRG
commands.summary: Merges layers into a target layer (objects move, the source layers are deleted).

commands.name: LAYOFF
commands.summary: Turns off the layer of each selected object.

commands.name: LAYON
commands.summary: Turns on all layers.

commands.name: LAYOUT
commands.summary: Creates, sets, renames and deletes sheets (layouts); sets paper size and title block.

commands.name: LAYOUTTABS
commands.summary: Shows or hides the Model / layout tabs under the drawing area.

commands.name: LAYRECONCILE
commands.summary: Marks unreconciled layers as reconciled (all, or the named ones).

commands.name: LAYTHW
commands.summary: Thaws all layers.

commands.name: LAYTRANS
commands.summary: Layer translator: maps layers to standard layers (mappings FROM=TO with wildcards, or a mapping file; standards from a drawing).

commands.name: LAYULK
commands.summary: Unlocks the layer of a selected object.

commands.name: LAYUNISO
commands.summary: Restores the layers hidden or locked by LAYISO.

commands.name: LAYWALK
commands.summary: Walks through layers showing only the chosen ones (name, pattern, Next/Previous, Filter), then restores them.

commands.name: LAZCONVERTER
commands.summary: Shows or sets the LAZ decompressor used to import .laz point clouds (laszip, pdal or las2las; stored in the drawing).

commands.name: LEADER
commands.summary: Creates a leader line with annotation text.

commands.name: LEFTVIEW
commands.summary: Sets the 3D view to left.

commands.name: LEGEND
commands.summary: Places a legend view: wall types, door/window types, floor/roof build-ups, components or materials (VIEWUPDATE refreshes it).

commands.name: LENGTHEN
commands.summary: Changes the length of lines, arcs and open polylines (Delta/Percent/Total).

commands.name: LEVEL
commands.summary: Lists, creates, sets, renames and deletes levels; sets elevation and height.

commands.name: LEVELAREAS
commands.summary: Area schedule by level: gross floor area (slabs, a 'gross' area plan or rooms) and net room area with the net/gross ratio; optional CSV.

commands.name: LEVELVIEW3D
commands.summary: 3D view by level: show All levels, Isolate one level, or Explode levels apart by a gap.

commands.name: LIBRARYINSTALL
commands.summary: Installs the free bundled block library (furniture, sanitary, kitchen, vehicles, people, trees, annotation symbols) into a folder and makes it the block library.

commands.name: LIGHT
commands.summary: Places point, spot, area, line or IES lights (lumens, colour temperature, beam) that light the 3D view and renders; List, On/Off.

commands.name: LIGHTDATA
commands.summary: Sets photometric data of light fixtures (lumens, watts, colour temperature, beam angle) used by schedules and rendering.

commands.name: LIGHTMIX
commands.summary: Light mix of path-traced renders: weights of the Sun, Sky and Artificial light groups, changeable after rendering (saved in the drawing).

commands.name: LIGHTSCHEDULE
commands.summary: Lighting fixture schedule (mark, type, level, room, position, rotation, lm, W, K) and average illuminance per room.

commands.name: LIMITS
commands.summary: Sets the drawing limits (LIMMIN/LIMMAX).

commands.name: LINE
commands.summary: Draws straight line segments.

commands.name: LINEANG
commands.summary: Draws a line from a point at a fixed angle and length.

commands.name: LINEAREXTRUDE
commands.summary: OpenSCAD-style linear extrude of closed profiles: height, twist angle and top scale (slices follow the twist).

commands.name: LINEBISECT
commands.summary: Draws the bisector of the angle between two lines from their intersection.

commands.name: LINEGAP
commands.summary: Cuts gaps in the selected objects where other objects cross them (crossing display).

commands.name: LINEHV
commands.summary: Draws horizontal or vertical lines (end points are projected).

commands.name: LINEPAR
commands.summary: Draws a line parallel to a picked line through a point.

commands.name: LINEPERP
commands.summary: Draws a line from a point perpendicular to a picked line (to its foot).

commands.name: LINEREL
commands.summary: Draws a line at an angle relative to a picked line or segment.

commands.name: LINESTYLES
commands.summary: Named line styles (weight, colour, pattern): New/Edit/Delete/List, Apply to objects, set a Layer's line style.

commands.name: LINETAN
commands.summary: Draws a line from a point tangent to a circle or arc.

commands.name: LINETAN2
commands.summary: Draws a common tangent of two circles (Outer or Inner), picked near the tangent points.

commands.name: LINETANORTHO
commands.summary: Draws a line tangent to a circle and perpendicular to a line (from the tangent point to the line).

commands.name: LINETYPE
commands.summary: Lists, loads, creates and sets the current linetype.

commands.name: LINEWORK
commands.summary: Overrides the line style of individual element edges in the current project view (Invisible, Hidden, Thin, Wide, Medium, Color, or Reset).

commands.name: LISP
commands.summary: Evaluates an AutoLISP expression, e.g. LISP "(command \"CIRCLE\" '(0 0) 500)"; the result is printed.

commands.name: LISPLOAD
commands.summary: Loads an AutoLISP (.lsp) file: its (defun c:NAME …) functions become commands; runs after this command, each (command …) its own undo step.

commands.name: LIST
commands.summary: Lists the properties of selected objects.

commands.name: LOADTAKEDOWN
commands.summary: Structural load takedown per column: tributary slab areas, dead (self weight + LOADSDL) and imposed loads by room usage, accumulated down the stacked columns, ULS 1.35G+1.5Q, SLS and axial stress; optional CSV.

commands.name: LOFT
commands.summary: Creates a solid through closed cross-sections at given heights (in selection order).

commands.name: LOOKAROUND
commands.summary: Looks around from the current eye point (drag or arrow keys turn the head; the camera does not move).

commands.name: LTSCALE
commands.summary: Sets the global linetype scale factor.

commands.name: LUPREC
commands.summary: System variable LUPREC.

commands.name: LWDISPLAY
commands.summary: System variable LWDISPLAY.

commands.name: LWDISPLAYSCALE
commands.summary: Screen display scale of lineweights (0.1–5, default 1); plotted widths are never changed.

commands.name: LWEIGHT
commands.summary: Sets the current lineweight and lineweight display.

commands.name: LWTABLE
commands.summary: Lineweight table by view scale: lineweights are multiplied by the factor of the current annotation scale (Set/Clear/List).

commands.name: MACRO
commands.summary: Runs a menu macro: spaces or ; = Enter, \ = pause for your input, ^C^C = cancel first (e.g. ^C^CLINE \ @1000,0 ;).

commands.name: MACROBUTTON
commands.summary: Creates, edits, lists, runs and deletes custom macro buttons (saved in the drawing or in your profile).

commands.name: MAKECOMPONENT
commands.summary: SketchUp-style component: the selected objects become a named definition and are replaced by an instance; every instance updates when the definition is edited (BEDIT/REFEDIT).

commands.name: MAKEGROUP
commands.summary: SketchUp-style group: the selected objects become one unique (unnamed) object that moves and copies as a whole.

commands.name: MAKEUNIQUE
commands.summary: Gives a component or group instance its own copy of the definition so it can be edited without changing the other instances.

commands.name: MARKS
commands.summary: Renumbers door and window marks per level in reading order (D01…, W01…), or sets a mark.

commands.name: MARKUP
commands.summary: Review markups stored in the drawing: Add (cloud + comment with author/date, linked to selected elements and the view), List, Resolve, Reopen, Reply, Zoom, Delete.

commands.name: MARKUPPANEL
commands.summary: Opens the markup/issue panel: filter open/resolved, reply, resolve, zoom to, link to the selection, BCF.

commands.name: MASKINGREGION
commands.summary: View-specific masking region on the current level: hides the model and drafting beneath it.

commands.name: MASSPROP
commands.summary: Reports area, perimeter, centroid, bounding box and volume of objects.

commands.name: MATASSET
commands.summary: Material assets kept apart from the render appearance: Identity (description, manufacturer, mark, cost), Graphics (shading colour, surface pattern) and Physical/thermal (density, conductivity, specific heat); List.

commands.name: MATBROWSER
commands.summary: Material library browser with rendered thumbnails: add to the drawing or assign to the selection.

commands.name: MATCHLINE
commands.summary: Matchlines between dependent views: On / Off / List.

commands.name: MATCHPROP
commands.summary: Applies the properties of a source object to other objects.

commands.name: MATEMISSIVE
commands.summary: Makes a material self-illuminated (luminance factor 0–20; 0 turns it off): screens, lamps, signs glow in 3D and renders.

commands.name: MATERIALS
commands.summary: Opens the material editor panel (color, roughness, metalness, transparency, texture).

commands.name: MATERIALTAG
commands.summary: Tags the material under a picked point (the layer of a compound wall, a slab's finish, or the element material); the tag follows material changes.

commands.name: MATFROMIMAGE
commands.summary: Creates a seamless PBR material from a photo: de-lit albedo, normal, roughness and AO maps derived from the image, at a real-world tile size.

commands.name: MATHATCH
commands.summary: Binds hatches to a material: they show its cut or surface pattern (and optionally its colour) and follow later pattern changes.

commands.name: MATMAPPING
commands.summary: Texture mapping of a material: Box, Planar, Cylindrical, Spherical or UV, and texture positioning (offset, rotation, scale) on its faces; Reset.

commands.name: MATMAPS
commands.summary: PBR texture maps of a material: Normal, Roughness, Metallic, AO and Displacement images, normal strength and displacement height; List/Clear.

commands.name: MATPATTERN
commands.summary: Sets the cut or surface fill pattern of a material; walls and bound hatches update everywhere.

commands.name: MATPATTERNDIALOG
commands.summary: Material Fill Patterns dialog: cut and surface pattern of every material; bound hatches and floor patterns update.

commands.name: MEASURE
commands.summary: Places points or blocks at measured intervals along an object.

commands.name: MEASURE3D
commands.summary: Measures in the 3D view: click two points on the model for distance and ΔX/ΔY/ΔZ.

commands.name: MEASUREGEOM
commands.summary: Measures distance, radius, angle, area or volume.

commands.name: MECHANISM
commands.summary: Mechanism simulation: steps a named driving dimension (angles in degrees) through a range, re-solving the constraints each step; draws the path of a traced point, optional ghost poses, reports lock-up and the range of other dimensions.

commands.name: MECHANISMPLAY
commands.summary: Animates a mechanism on the plan: steps a named driving dimension through a range (re-solving the constraints) and plays the poses Once, in a Loop or Bounce; Stop ends it. The drawing is not changed.

commands.name: MEMORYREPORT
commands.summary: Memory estimate of the drawing by kind, the app's memory footprint and the budget (MEMORYBUDGET MB) with advice; POINTLIMIT follows the budget.

commands.name: MEPCONNECTORS
commands.summary: Lists plumbing/electrical connection points of fixtures and shows or hides them in plan.

commands.name: MEPPIPE
commands.summary: Draws pipes along points with elbow fittings at bends; can start at a plumbing fixture connector, slope and rise.

commands.name: MEPSYSTEM
commands.summary: Connector-based systems: list connected networks, assign a system to a whole network, show only some systems, or check open ends.

commands.name: MESH
commands.summary: Faceted mesh primitives with divisions (MESHDIVISIONS): Box, Cylinder, Cone, Sphere, Torus, Wedge, Pyramid.

commands.name: MESHDECIMATE
commands.summary: Reduces the triangle count of meshes/solids to a percentage (vertex clustering).

commands.name: MESHEXTRUDE
commands.summary: Extrudes faces of a solid or mesh (the faces facing Top/Bottom/Front/Back/Left/Right under a picked point, or All facing that way) by a distance along their normal; the result stays closed.

commands.name: MESHIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports an OBJ, STL, 3MF, glTF/GLB, PLY, OFF, AMF or COLLADA (.dae) file as mesh solids (choose the file's units where the format has none).

commands.name: MESHREPAIR
commands.summary: Repairs meshes/solids: welds vertices, removes degenerate and duplicate faces, fixes orientation, fills holes.

commands.name: MESHSECTION
commands.summary: Cross-sections of solids and meshes: section curves at one elevation or every interval between two elevations (for contours, ribs, waffle models).

commands.name: MESHSMOOTH
commands.summary: Smooths solids and meshes by Loop subdivision (1–4 levels).

commands.name: MINKOWSKI
commands.summary: Minkowski sum of two solids (e.g. a box and a sphere for rounded edges); exact for convex solids.

commands.name: MIRROR
commands.summary: Creates a mirrored copy of objects.

commands.name: MIRROR3D
commands.summary: Mirrors solids about the XY, YZ or ZX plane through a point, or a vertical plane through two points.

commands.name: MIRRORFEATURE
commands.summary: Mirrors a feature (or the whole body) about a vertical plane through two points or the XY plane at a height; stays parametric.

commands.name: MIRRTEXT
commands.summary: System variable MIRRTEXT.

commands.name: MLEADER
commands.summary: Creates a multileader (arrowhead, landing, text).

commands.name: MLEADERALIGN
commands.summary: Aligns the landings (text) of leaders with a reference leader, vertically or horizontally.

commands.name: MLEADERCOLLECT
commands.summary: Collects several leaders into one: the first leader's arrow with all texts stacked (Vertical) or in a row (Horizontal) at a new landing.

commands.name: MLEADERSTYLE
commands.summary: Creates, edits, lists and sets multileader styles (text height, annotative, layer, arrowhead, landing, text frame).

commands.name: MLINE
commands.summary: Draws multiple parallel lines (multiline style, scale, Top/Zero/Bottom justification), grouped.

commands.name: MLSTYLE
commands.summary: Multiline styles: New (element offsets, caps), Set current, List, Delete.

commands.name: MODELGROUP
commands.summary: Model groups: create a named group of elements, place instances, update all instances from an edited one, list, or ungroup.

commands.name: MODELMERGE
commands.summary: Three-way merge: combines another branch of the drawing (theirs) into this one using their common ancestor (base); non-conflicting changes of both sides are kept, conflicts keep ours and are listed.

commands.name: MOVE
commands.summary: Moves objects a specified distance in a specified direction.

commands.name: MOVEROTATE
commands.summary: Moves objects from a base point to a destination, then rotates them about it.

commands.name: MOVEZ
commands.summary: Moves objects up or down: element base/top offsets and door/window sills change, solids move (one undo step).

commands.name: MTEXT
commands.summary: Creates paragraph (multiline) text inside a width.

commands.name: MTEXTCOLUMNS
commands.summary: Sets columns on multiline text: Static (count, balanced), Dynamic (fixed column height) or No columns.

commands.name: MVIEW
commands.summary: Places a viewport on the current sheet (corners in paper mm, scale 1:n, view kind, level).

commands.name: MVIEWPOLY
commands.summary: Creates a polygonal sheet viewport from paper points (x,y in mm) showing the current level.

commands.name: MVSETUP
commands.summary: Aligns sheet viewports: pans one viewport so a model point lines up horizontally or vertically with a point in another.

commands.name: NAVIGATOR
commands.summary: Navigator: overview map of the whole drawing with the visible area; drag the rectangle to pan.

commands.name: NAVSWHEEL
commands.summary: Steering wheel in 3D: Zoom, Orbit, Pan, Rewind (outer ring), Center, Walk, Up/Down, Look (inner ring).

commands.name: NAVVCUBE
commands.summary: Shows or hides the view cube in 3D.

commands.name: NEISO
commands.summary: Sets the 3D view to neiso.

commands.name: NEW
commands.summary: Creates a new drawing.

commands.name: NEWFROMTEMPLATE
commands.summary: Starts a new drawing from a template (built-in or from the templates folder).

commands.name: NICHE
commands.summary: Cuts a recess of a given depth into one face of a wall.

commands.name: NODEEDITOR
commands.summary: Visual node editor (number, point, line, circle, extrude, array…) with live preview; bakes geometry into the drawing.

commands.name: NODEPACKAGE
commands.summary: Custom node packages (.archinodes): Create one from the drawing's node graph (a snippet per group), Install a file, Insert a snippet into the graph, List, Remove.

commands.name: NORTHARROW
commands.summary: Places a north arrow symbol (defaults to project north).

commands.name: NOTIFICATIONS
commands.summary: Notifications centre: model warnings (overlaps, unhosted openings, family errors, missing blocks) — click one to zoom to it.

commands.name: NUDGE
commands.summary: Moves the selection by small steps: Left/Right/Up/Down (× count), or a vector dx,dy (arrow-key nudging).

commands.name: NWISO
commands.summary: Sets the 3D view to nwiso.

commands.name: OBJECTSCALE
commands.summary: Adds or deletes annotation scales of annotative objects (shown only at their scales when ANNOALLVISIBLE is 0).

commands.name: OBJECTSTYLES
commands.summary: Object styles: project-wide projection/cut line weights, line colour, cut fill and cut pattern per BIM category (wall, door, window, slab, column…); every plan and section follows. List, Reset, or set e.g. "cut:0.7;proj:0.35;color:red;fill:0.3,0.3,0.3;pattern:ANSI31".

commands.name: OBJECTSTYLESDIALOG
