commands.summary: Object Styles dialog: projection/cut line weights, line colour, cut fill and cut pattern per BIM category for every plan and section.

commands.name: OFFSET
commands.summary: Creates parallel copies of lines, arcs, circles and polylines.

commands.name: OFFSETDIST
commands.summary: System variable OFFSETDIST.

commands.name: OFFSETFACE
commands.summary: SketchUp-style Offset: imprints a copy of a planar face's edges offset into the face (then SUBOBJECT Extrude pushes or pulls the inner face).

commands.name: OFFSETMULTI
commands.summary: Creates several equidistant offset copies of an object on one side.

commands.name: OFFSETSOLID
commands.summary: Offsets solids: every face moves outwards (or inwards, negative) by the distance.

commands.name: OOPS
commands.summary: Restores the objects removed by the last ERASE.

commands.name: OPEN
commands.summary: Opens a drawing (.archi, .dxf).

commands.name: OPENING
commands.summary: Cuts empty openings in walls.

commands.name: OPENINGFLIP
commands.summary: Flips doors and windows: Hand (hinge side), Facing (swing / exterior side) or Both.

commands.name: OPENINGPARTS
commands.summary: Sets window mullions/transoms and door fanlights/thresholds on selected openings.

commands.name: OPENINGTRIM
commands.summary: Sets door/window casings (architraves), an interior window board and a lintel with bearings on selected openings.

commands.name: OPENINGTYPE
commands.summary: Door/window type catalog: list, new, set type parameters and sub-parts (mullions, transoms, threshold), formulas, apply to openings, delete, import CSV.

commands.name: OPTIONS
commands.summary: Opens Settings: units, grid and snaps, autosave, colors, shortcuts, toolbar, agents.

commands.name: ORBITSELECTION
commands.summary: Orbits around (and zooms to) the selected elements in 3D.

commands.name: ORTHO
commands.summary: Constrains cursor movement to horizontal/vertical (F8).

commands.name: ORTHOMODE
commands.summary: System variable ORTHOMODE.

commands.name: OSMIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports an OpenStreetMap .osm extract around the project location: building outlines (optionally extruded to their height), roads, water and areas.

commands.name: OSMODE
commands.summary: System variable OSMODE.

commands.name: OSNAP
commands.summary: Sets running object snap modes (END,MID,CEN,NOD,QUA,INT,EXT,INS,PER,TAN,NEA,PAR,APP,GCEN, ON/OFF).

commands.name: OTRACK
commands.summary: System variable OTRACK.

commands.name: OUTLINER
commands.summary: Outliner: lists the hierarchy of groups, components and model groups; Select instances by name (wildcards), Rename an instance, or Convert it to a BIM element.

commands.name: OUTLINERPANEL
commands.summary: Outliner window: the tree of groups, components, blocks and model groups; click selects, double-click zooms, filter by name.

commands.name: OVERKILL
commands.summary: Removes duplicate objects and merges overlapping collinear lines.

commands.name: PAD
commands.summary: PartDesign pad: extrudes a sketch profile (optionally tapered) and adds it to a solid, or creates a new body; regenerates when the sketch changes.

commands.name: PAGESETUP
commands.summary: Page setup of the active sheet or model: paper, plot style, lineweights, plot stamp, scale.

commands.name: PAINT
commands.summary: Paint bucket: applies a material to objects and building elements by clicking them; Sample picks up an object's material; List shows the materials.

commands.name: PAN
commands.summary: Moves the view by a displacement.

commands.name: PANELSCHEDULE
commands.summary: Panel schedule of an electrical panel (circuits, loads, breakers, phase balance): List, Place as a table or Export CSV.

commands.name: PANORAMA
commands.summary: Renders a 360° equirectangular panorama (PNG/JPEG) from the 3D camera position or a picked plan point.

commands.name: PARABOLA
commands.summary: Draws a parabola from its vertex, focus and half-width (as a smooth polyline).

commands.name: PARAMCELL
commands.summary: Drives a global parameter from a spreadsheet cell (a table in the drawing, e.g. Params!B3 or #12!B3); None removes the link.

commands.name: PARAMETERS
commands.summary: Parameters manager: New/Edit/Delete/List user parameters and dimensional constraint expressions; geometry updates.

commands.name: PARKINGCHECK
commands.summary: Parking provision check: required spaces from room usage and area (PARKINGRULES, e.g. office=35;apartment=unit:1) against the parking spaces placed, including accessible spaces.

commands.name: PARKINGLOT
commands.summary: Lays out a row (or double row with aisle) of parking bays at 90°, 60° or 45° with paving.

commands.name: PARTS
commands.summary: Divides compound walls into parts (one per layer, cut by the host's openings), Merge restores the wall, Material overrides a part, Show Parts/Original.

commands.name: PASTEBLOCK
commands.summary: Pastes the clipboard as a block reference.

commands.name: PASTECLIP
commands.summary: Pastes the clipboard at an insertion point.

commands.name: PASTEORIG
commands.summary: Pastes the clipboard at its original coordinates.

commands.name: PASTESPECIAL
commands.summary: Pastes what another app copied — SVG or PDF vectors, pictures, DXF text, plain text or Explorer files — at an insertion point.

commands.name: PASTETOPOINTS
commands.summary: Pastes the clipboard at several picked points (one undo step).

commands.name: PATHTRACE
commands.summary: Progressive path-traced render of the 3D view (GGX materials, glass refraction, PBR maps, sun, sky, lights): Window, or File with size, samples and denoising.

commands.name: PATLOAD
commands.summary: Loads hatch patterns from an AutoCAD .pat file into the drawing (saved with it).

commands.name: PATTERNFEATURE
commands.summary: Repeats a feature (or the whole body) in a Linear (columns × rows) or Polar pattern; instances follow the feature's sketch.

commands.name: PCPLANE
commands.summary: Snaps to the scan point nearest a picked location and fits the plane through its neighbours: reports the point, normal, slope and fit error; a vertical plane is drawn as a line along its trace in plan.

commands.name: PDFATTACH
commands.summary: Attaches a PDF page as an underlay (by reference, faded and locked, with object snaps on its geometry) at a drawing scale and insertion point.

commands.name: PDFIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports the vectors and text of a PDF page as drawing objects: paths with their colours and line widths, fills as solid hatches, text (ToUnicode aware), PDF layers (optional content) as layers; at a drawing scale and insertion point.

commands.name: PDFMARKUPS
commands.summary: Imports the comments of a PDF page (notes, clouds/rectangles, ink, lines, highlights) as review markups with author and date, placed with the plot scale and origin and linked to the elements under them.

commands.name: PDFUNDERLAYS
commands.summary: Manages PDF underlays: List, Reload (re-read changed PDFs), Detach, Fade (0–90 %).

commands.name: PDMODE
commands.summary: System variable PDMODE.

commands.name: PDSIZE
commands.summary: System variable PDSIZE.

commands.name: PEDIT
commands.summary: Edits polylines: close/open, join, width, spline, decurve, reverse.

commands.name: PENSETS
commands.summary: Pen sets mapping pen numbers (colour indexes) to plotted weights and colours: New/Pen/Current/Display/Delete/List.

commands.name: PERSPECTIVE
commands.summary: 3D projection: 1 = perspective, 0 = parallel (orthographic).

commands.name: PHASE
commands.summary: Manages construction phases: list, new, current phase, filter, created/demolished phase of objects.

commands.name: PHASEANIMATION
commands.summary: Construction sequence (4D) video from the phases (new elements appear bottom-up, demolished ones disappear) or from the work schedule (day by day), captioned (MP4).

commands.name: PICKSTYLE
commands.summary: System variable PICKSTYLE.

commands.name: PIPE
commands.summary: Creates a round pipe (optionally hollow) along a path.

commands.name: PLAN
commands.summary: Shows the plan view of the current UCS, a named UCS or the world (rotates the 2D display so the UCS X axis is horizontal).

commands.name: PLANESURF
commands.summary: Planar surface from a closed boundary (Object, with inner loops as holes) or from two corners of a rectangle.

commands.name: PLANGEN
commands.summary: Generates floor plan options from a room programme ("Living 25, Kitchen 12, Bedroom 14 x2, Bath 6, Hall 8" in m²) inside a W × D footprint: lists scored options, builds the chosen one (walls, rooms, doors, windows) after confirmation, one undo step.

commands.name: PLANORIENT
commands.summary: Orients the plan to Project north (up) or True north (display rotation only).

commands.name: PLINE
commands.summary: Draws a 2D polyline of line and arc segments.

commands.name: PLINETOSPLINE
commands.summary: Converts polylines (and lines) to splines fitted through their vertices.

commands.name: PLINEWID
commands.summary: System variable PLINEWID.

commands.name: PLOT
commands.summary: Plots the current sheet or view to PDF or a printer.

commands.name: PLOTAREA
commands.summary: Model-space plot area (Extents/Display/Limits/Window) and fit (Standard scale or Exact) for PLOT, PREVIEW and PDF export.

commands.name: PLOTLOG
commands.summary: Shows the plot log (every plot, PDF export and publish with date, sheets and plot style) [List/Open/Clear].

commands.name: PLOTSTYLE
commands.summary: Plot style tables (colour → pen colour, lineweight, screening): Edit, Set for the sheet/model, List.

commands.name: PLOTSTYLENAME
commands.summary: Named plot styles (STB): assign a style to a Layer or to Objects, choose the Table used by the current sheet (or model), or List styles.

commands.name: PLOTTRANSPARENCY
commands.summary: System variable PLOTTRANSPARENCY.

commands.name: PLUGINS
commands.summary: Plugin manager: List plugins (folders with plugin.json + JavaScript), Reload and register their commands, Enable/Disable, Info, New (scaffold a plugin, optionally from a recorded script), Folder.

commands.name: PLYOUT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as an ASCII PLY mesh (millimetres, Z up, vertex colours from materials).

commands.name: POCKET
commands.summary: PartDesign pocket: cuts a sketch profile into a solid by a depth (downwards from the sketch) or Through all; regenerates when the sketch changes.

commands.name: POINT
commands.summary: Creates point objects (style: PDMODE/PDSIZE).

commands.name: POINTCLOUDIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports a point cloud (XYZ, PTS or PLY ASCII/binary) as point entities with colours, decimated to a point budget and/or a voxel grid.

commands.name: POINTCLOUDVIEW
commands.summary: Point cloud display: Clip to a section box (min/max corners with Z range), Density (octree level of detail: keep at most N points shown, evenly over the cloud), Reset (show all). Hidden points move to layer POINTCLOUD-HIDDEN.

commands.name: POINTINSIDE
commands.summary: Tells whether a point is inside, outside or on a closed contour (polyline, circle, ellipse, hatch, room, slab).

commands.name: POINTLATTICE
commands.summary: Places a lattice of points (columns × rows at given spacings, optional angle).

commands.name: POINTSEXPORT
commands.summary: Writes point entities (selection or all) to CSV: name,x,y,z,code,layer.

commands.name: POINTSIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports survey points from CSV/TSV/TXT (X,Y[,Z][,name] with or without header, or P,N,E,Z,D).

commands.name: POINTSLINE
commands.summary: Places a number of evenly spaced points between two points (both ends included).

commands.name: POLARANG
commands.summary: System variable POLARANG.

commands.name: POLARMODE
commands.summary: System variable POLARMODE.

commands.name: POLYGON
commands.summary: Draws an equilateral closed polyline.

commands.name: POLYGONSS
commands.summary: Draws a regular polygon from the midpoint of one side and the opposite side (odd sides: opposite vertex).

commands.name: POLYHEDRON
commands.summary: Solid from points (x,y,z) and faces (point numbers from 1, e.g. 1,2,3,4) like OpenSCAD polyhedron().

commands.name: POLYSOLID
commands.summary: Draws a wall-like solid along points or converts a line/polyline/arc (Object); Height, Width, Justify.

commands.name: POSITIONCAMERA
commands.summary: Places the camera at a plan point at eye height looking towards a second point, then looks around (SketchUp style).

commands.name: PRESENTOUT
commands.summary: Writes the sheets and saved views as a self-contained HTML slide show (full screen with F, arrow keys, speaker notes from the sheet field 'notes').

commands.name: PRESSPULL
commands.summary: Extrudes the area around a picked point (with islands as holes), a closed object, or changes an extrusion's height.

commands.name: PRESSPULLFACE
commands.summary: Pushes or pulls a planar face (top, bottom or side) of any 3D solid along its normal.

commands.name: PREVIEW
commands.summary: Plot dialog with a live preview: prints or saves exactly what is shown.

commands.name: PRINTSETUP
commands.summary: Prints with printer, paper, tray (input slot), media, scaling (fit, 1:1, percent) and copies.

commands.name: PRISM
commands.summary: Regular prism (N sides) or tube (inner radius > 0): centre, circumradius, height.

commands.name: PROCMATERIAL
commands.summary: Procedural seamless material (Wood, Brick, Tile, Marble, Stone, Concrete, Terrazzo) with albedo, normal and roughness maps from colours, courses, joint width and a seed.

commands.name: PROFILE
commands.summary: Profile families for sweeps, handrails, gutters and mullions: list, create from a closed polyline (flexes with Width/Height), or delete.

commands.name: PROJECTBASEPOINT
commands.summary: Project base point: its location, shared coordinates (easting/northing) and elevation; List or Reset.

commands.name: PROJECTGEOMETRY
commands.summary: Projects the outline of solids onto the sketch plane as closed polylines that follow the solids when they change (use them as sketch profiles).

commands.name: PROJECTVIEW
commands.summary: Project views: New (plan / ceiling / 3D), Open, Close, Duplicate (plain, with detailing, as dependent), Split into dependent views, Rename, Delete, List.

commands.name: PROPERTIES
commands.summary: Shows the properties of the selected object(s).

commands.name: PROPERTYLINE
commands.summary: Draws property lines by points or bearings and distances; labels bearings, distances and the enclosed area.

commands.name: PSET
commands.summary: Property sets (IFC Psets): Set Pset.Property values (typed by templates), Apply a template's defaults, List an element's sets, Remove, Check values, and custom Templates (New/Add/Delete/List).

commands.name: PSETUPIN
commands.summary: Imports a page setup (plot style, colour mode, lineweights, stamp, paper) from another drawing into the current sheet or all sheets.

commands.name: PTYPE
commands.summary: Sets the point display style (PDMODE) and size (PDSIZE).

commands.name: PUBLISH
commands.summary: Publishes all sheets to one multi-page PDF (PUBLISH path.pdf, or Enter for a dialog).

commands.name: PURGE
commands.summary: Removes unused blocks, layers, linetypes, text styles and dimension styles.

commands.name: PYRAMID
commands.summary: Creates a pyramid or frustum with N sides: base centre, base radius, height (Top radius for a frustum).

commands.name: QAASSIST
commands.summary: Model QA assistant: explains each model-checker finding (why it matters, what to do), Zoom to one, or Fix one / all fixable issues automatically after confirmation (one undo step).

commands.name: QDIM
commands.summary: Quickly dimensions selected objects: Continuous, Staggered, Baseline, Ordinate, Radius, Diameter, datumPoint.

commands.name: QSELECT
commands.summary: Quick select: objects of a type whose property matches a value (e.g. QSELECT Circle radius > 50).

commands.name: QSELECTDIALOG
commands.summary: Quick Select dialog: type, property, operator and value with a live match count.

commands.name: QUICKPROPS
commands.summary: Quick Properties: a compact editor of the selection's key properties over the drawing.

commands.name: QUIT
commands.summary: Quits the application.

commands.name: RADIALGRID
commands.summary: Creates a radial grid system: centre, start angle, angular spacings (e.g. 6*15), inner radius and radial spacings; numbered radial grids and lettered arc grids.

commands.name: RADIALMENU
commands.summary: Right-drag marking menu with the 8 most used commands for the context (On/Off/List).

commands.name: RAILING
commands.summary: Draws a railing along a path, or on both sides of a Stair's flights (sloped, following the stair).

commands.name: RAILINGTYPE
commands.summary: Sets the railing type of selected railings: preset (Balusters, Glass, Cable, Bars, Wooden, Handrail) or handrail profile, baluster spacing and extensions.

commands.name: RAILTYPEDEF
commands.summary: Named railing types (height, handrail profile and size, infill, balusters, posts, extensions): New / Edit (railings of the type follow), Assign, List, Delete.

commands.name: RAINWATER
commands.summary: Rainwater from roofs: plan area incl. overhangs, runoff coefficient, design flow Q = C·i·A, downpipes (EN 12056-3 capacities), gutter length and annual harvest; optional CSV.

commands.name: RAMP
commands.summary: Creates a sloped ramp (straight or along a path with turns), with landings between flights; warns above 1:12.

commands.name: RAY
commands.summary: Draws semi-infinite construction lines from a start point through each given point.

commands.name: RCP
commands.summary: Reflected ceiling plan on/off (ceilings with grids and heights, ceiling fixtures), and ceiling grid settings.

commands.name: REBAR
commands.summary: Reinforcement in a concrete beam (Bottom/Top bars, Links), column (Vertical bars, Links) or slab (X/Y mesh): cover, bar diameter, count or spacing, BS 8666 shape codes; List prints the bar schedule.

commands.name: RECOVER
commands.summary: Opens a damaged .archi drawing, repairing it: truncated files are closed after the last complete object, undecodable objects and settings are dropped, and the model is audited.

commands.name: RECOVERYFILES
commands.summary: Lists the autosave copies and change journals left by a crash or forced quit, and opens one (Open n) or deletes them (Clear).

commands.name: RECTANG
commands.summary: Draws a rectangular polyline (optionally filleted or chamfered).

commands.name: REDO
commands.summary: Reverses the last undo.

commands.name: REFCLOSE
commands.summary: Ends in-place reference editing: Save writes the changes to the block definition, Discard restores it.

commands.name: REFEDIT
commands.summary: Edits a block reference in place; REFSET adds or removes objects, REFCLOSE saves or discards.

commands.name: REFSET
commands.summary: Adds drawing objects to, or removes objects from, the in-place reference working set.

commands.name: REGEN
commands.summary: Regenerates the display.

commands.name: REGION
commands.summary: Converts closed chains of lines/arcs into closed polylines (regions).

commands.name: REGIONINTERSECT
commands.summary: Keeps the common area of closed 2D regions (as closed polylines).

commands.name: REGIONSUBTRACT
commands.summary: Subtracts closed 2D regions from others (result as closed polylines; holes become separate polylines).

commands.name: REGIONUNION
commands.summary: Unites closed 2D regions (closed polylines, circles, ellipses, hatches) into closed polylines.

commands.name: RELZERO
commands.summary: Sets the relative zero (the point @ input is measured from), or locks / unlocks it.

commands.name: RENAME
commands.summary: Renames blocks, layers, linetypes, text styles, dimension styles, levels, views and wall types.

commands.name: RENDER
commands.summary: Renders the 3D model.

commands.name: RENDERPRESET
commands.summary: Photographic lighting preset of the Realistic view and renders: Daylight, Golden hour, Overcast or Night (glowing windows); Off returns to the default look.

commands.name: RENDERPROMPT
commands.summary: Styles the render from a description (e.g. “golden hour, soft shadows, warm, 4K”): saves it as the “Prompt” render preset and opens the render window.

commands.name: RENDERQUEUE
commands.summary: Render queue: add the current view or saved cameras, render them in turn to PNG files; render history with thumbnails.

commands.name: RENDERSAVE
commands.summary: Renders offscreen to a PNG without the render window: RENDERSAVE <preset> <camera|Current> <width> <height> <path> (4× MSAA + supersampling, vertical correction for eye-level cameras).

commands.name: RENDERTOFILE
commands.summary: Renders to an image file: any size up to 7680×4320 (tiled), a pass (Beauty, Alpha, Depth, Normal, Material ID), a style (Photographic, Sketch, Watercolour) and an optional region of the frame.

commands.name: REPEATDETAIL
commands.summary: Repeating detail: a component arrayed along a path (brick courses, blocking); editing the path or spacing regenerates it.

commands.name: REPORTPARAM
commands.summary: Makes a family parameter a reporting parameter measured from the model (host.thickness, host.height, host.length, level.elevation, level.height, self.rotation…).

commands.name: RESETBLOCK
commands.summary: Resets block references to their block definition (dynamic values and visibility state).

commands.name: RESOLVECONFLICTS
commands.summary: Finds the sync-conflict copies of the drawing (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive…) and merges them in (three-way, nothing lost; true conflicts keep yours and are listed); merged copies move to <name>.archi-conflicts/.

commands.name: RESUME
commands.summary: Continues a script that was interrupted with Escape.

commands.name: RETAININGWALL
commands.summary: Draws a cantilever retaining wall (battered stem on a footing) along points; retained side on the right of travel.

commands.name: REVCLOUD
commands.summary: Draws a revision cloud: polygonal, rectangular, freehand, from an object or enclosing objects (attached: it moves with them); tagged with the current revision.

commands.name: REVCLOUDLIST
commands.summary: Lists revision clouds by revision, selects the clouds of one revision, and adds missing revisions to the revision table.

commands.name: REVCLOUDPANEL
commands.summary: Sheet revision clouds: add a cloud with a revision triangle around a viewport or an area of a sheet, list, open, delete.

commands.name: REVEALHIDDEN
commands.summary: Reveal hidden elements: On draws temporarily hidden objects in magenta, Off stops, Unhide restores objects by id (#12,#15) or All.

commands.name: REVERB
commands.summary: Reverberation time (Sabine RT60 at 500 Hz) of each room from its volume and surface absorption; optional CSV.

commands.name: REVERSE
commands.summary: Reverses the vertex order of lines, polylines, splines and arcs.

commands.name: REVOLUTION
commands.summary: PartDesign revolution: revolves a sketch profile about an axis and adds it to a body (follows the sketch).

commands.name: REVOLVE
commands.summary: Revolves closed 2D objects about an axis into 3D solids (associative: the solid regenerates when the profile is edited; DELOBJ 1 deletes profiles).

commands.name: REVSTAMP
commands.summary: Revision stamps: a numbered revision triangle, or a new row in the revision table; advances the drawing revision (REVNUMBER).

commands.name: REVSURF
commands.summary: Revolved mesh surface: rotates a path curve about an axis line (start angle, included angle; SURFTAB1 segments).

commands.name: RHINOIN
commands.summary: Imports a Rhino .3dm file (versions 2–8): meshes, B-reps (render meshes or tessellated trimmed faces), extrusions, surfaces, curves, points and blocks, with layers, colours, materials and units.

commands.name: RHINOOUT
commands.summary: Exports a Rhino .3dm (version 4) file in the drawing units: the 3D model as meshes coloured by material, drafting curves as exact lines, arcs, polylines and NURBS, with layers.

commands.name: RIGHTVIEW
commands.summary: Sets the 3D view to right.

commands.name: ROOF
commands.summary: Creates a flat, shed, gable or hip roof from a footprint.

commands.name: ROOFEDGE
commands.summary: Adds fascia boards, gutters (profile) and soffits along the eaves of roofs.

commands.name: ROOFEXTRUSION
commands.summary: Roof by extrusion: pick an open polyline drawn as the roof profile (x = across, y = height), then the start, direction and length of the extrusion and the eave height.

commands.name: ROOFJOIN
commands.summary: Joins a roof to another: the picked edge is extended until the roof meets the other roof and the part below it is cut away (Unjoin restores it).

commands.name: ROOFSHAPE
commands.summary: Changes roofs into Mansard or Gambrel (two pitches with a break) forms, a Dome or a Barrel vault, or back to Plain.

commands.name: ROOFSHAPEPOINTS
commands.summary: Shape editing of flat roofs: Add points with a height (drainage falls, ridges) or raise the corners, List, Reset; the roof top becomes a triangulated surface.

commands.name: ROOM
commands.summary: Places rooms bounded by walls (pick inside) or by points; reports area.

commands.name: ROOMBOUNDING
commands.summary: Sets whether walls, curtain walls and columns bound rooms (used by ROOM, ROOMUPDATE and SLAB Walls).

commands.name: ROOMDATASHEET
commands.summary: Room data sheets: Show per-room reports, Export (CSV/HTML/text), Import an edited CSV back into the rooms, or Set one field.

commands.name: ROOMFINISH
commands.summary: Sets room floor/base/wall/ceiling finishes and places the room finish schedule.

commands.name: ROOMSCHEDULE
commands.summary: Room area schedule with net (minus columns) and gross (to wall centre lines) areas, perimeter and volume; optional CSV.

commands.name: ROOMSEPARATOR
commands.summary: Draws room separation lines (virtual room boundaries used by ROOM, SLAB Walls, ROOMUPDATE).

commands.name: ROOMUPDATE
commands.summary: Recomputes the boundaries and areas of rooms placed by picking, after walls or separation lines changed.

commands.name: ROTATE
commands.summary: Rotates objects around a base point.

commands.name: ROTATE2
commands.summary: Rotates objects about a first centre, then about a second centre.

commands.name: ROTATE3D
commands.summary: Rotates solids about an axis parallel to X, Y or Z through a point.

commands.name: ROTATE90
commands.summary: Rotates the selection 90° counter-clockwise (or [Clockwise]) about its centre or a base point.

commands.name: RP
commands.summary: Draws a named reference plane (work plane) or lists, renames, deletes one or makes it the current UCS.

commands.name: RULESURF
commands.summary: Ruled mesh surface between two curves (SURFTAB1 rulings).

commands.name: RVTLINK
commands.summary: Linked BIM models (.archi/IFC): list, Attach (origin-to-origin, shared coordinates or a point), Reload, Unload, Detach, Position, Notify.

commands.name: SAMPLEHOUSE
commands.summary: Opens the bundled sample house project in a new window.

commands.name: SANDBOX
commands.summary: Sandbox terrain tools: Grid (terrain from scratch), Smoove (raise/lower with falloff), Stamp (flat pad with side slopes), Drape (project curves onto the terrain), ToBIM (toposurface → BIM topography element).

commands.name: SAVE
commands.summary: Saves the drawing.

commands.name: SAVEAS
commands.summary: Saves the drawing under a new name.

commands.name: SAVEASTEMPLATE
commands.summary: Saves the drawing's settings, layers, styles and content as a template in the templates folder.

commands.name: SAVECAMERA
commands.summary: Saves the current 3D camera by name (restored with CAMERA).

commands.name: SAVECHECK
commands.summary: Verifies that saving and reopening the drawing gives an identical document (lists any section that would change).

commands.name: SAVECOPY
commands.summary: Saves a copy of the drawing under another name or format (.archi, .architemplate, .dxf, .ifc, …); the open drawing keeps its name and unsaved state.

commands.name: SAVETIME
commands.summary: Sets the autosave interval in minutes (0 turns autosave off).

commands.name: SCAD
commands.summary: Evaluates an OpenSCAD-language script (cube, sphere, cylinder, polyhedron, extrudes, transforms, union/difference/intersection/hull/minkowski, modules, loops) into a solid.

commands.name: SCADFILE
commands.summary: Imports an OpenSCAD .scad file (with include / use of neighbouring files) as a solid.

commands.name: SCADOBJECT
commands.summary: Scripted parametric objects (OpenSCAD language, GDL-like): New from a script or File, list Params (Customizer ranges and choices), Set a parameter to regenerate.

commands.name: SCALE
commands.summary: Enlarges or reduces objects around a base point.

commands.name: SCALE3D
commands.summary: Non-uniform scale of solids about a base point: separate X, Y and Z factors (negative factors mirror), or Handles: drag a bounding-box handle (corner, edge midpoint, Top/Bottom) about the opposite side or the Center, optionally Uniform.

commands.name: SCALEBAR
commands.summary: Places a graphic scale bar (segments, segment length, labels in m or drawing units).

commands.name: SCALELISTEDIT
commands.summary: Edits the list of annotation scales (Add/Delete/Reset/List).

commands.name: SCALETEXT
commands.summary: Changes the height of text objects (new height or scale factor) keeping their insertion points.

commands.name: SCANTOBIM
commands.summary: Detects planes in the point cloud (RANSAC) and creates walls from vertical planes and floor slabs from horizontal planes.

commands.name: SCATTER
commands.summary: Scatters Grass, Flowers, Shrubs or Trees over closed boundaries with Poisson-disk spacing at a density per m² (reproducible seed); shown in the viewport and renders.

commands.name: SCHEDULE
commands.summary: Creates a schedule table (walls, doors, windows, rooms, slabs…) or prints it; Define/Edit/Export/Import/Place manage stored schedules (fields, filters, sorting, grouping, totals, round-trip editing, CSV/XLSX, sheets).

commands.name: SCHEDULECELLS
commands.summary: Conditional formatting of schedules: highlight the Row or only the Cell of a field when "field op value" holds (shown in placed schedules); Clear.

commands.name: SCOPEBOX
commands.summary: Scope boxes: New (two corners, rotation), Grids (assign grids — they are trimmed to the box), View (crop a project view by the box), Delete, List.

commands.name: SCRIPT
commands.summary: Runs a script file of command lines.

commands.name: SCRIPT2JS
commands.summary: Converts a command script (.scr, or the running SCRIPTRECORD recording) into JavaScript calling archi.run() per command.

commands.name: SCRIPTCOMPONENT
commands.summary: GDL-like scripted BIM objects: Place a component from an OpenSCAD script (file, or a script solid) whose Customizer parameters become instance parameters; Set a parameter (range-checked) to flex it; List its parameters.

commands.name: SCRIPTCONSOLE
commands.summary: Shows or hides the JavaScript console (Ctrl+Alt+J).

commands.name: SCRIPTLIBRARY
commands.summary: Opens the script library folder (startup.js runs in every new window).

commands.name: SCRIPTRECORD
commands.summary: Records typed commands and picks as a script (Start/Stop); saved to a .scr file.

commands.name: SCRIPTTEXT
commands.summary: Runs command lines given as text (lines separated by newlines, \n or |).

commands.name: SEASON
commands.summary: Season of the vegetation in the 3D view and renders: Spring, Summer, Autumn or Winter colours for grass, trees and plants.

commands.name: SECTION
commands.summary: Places a section line (A–A…) in plan; section views and sheets use the current section.

commands.name: SECTIONBOX
commands.summary: Section box in 3D: On/Off/Selection/Level/Reset; the box is saved with the drawing.

commands.name: SECTIONOBJECT
commands.summary: Section plane objects: Add a named vertical plane (its plan trace can be moved), make it Live (clips the 3D view with caps), Flip, Generate/update its 2D section block, Slice solids into closed halves, List, Off, Delete.

commands.name: SECTIONPLANE
commands.summary: Live section plane in 3D with cap faces: Horizontal at a height, Vertical through two plan points, Flip, Off.

commands.name: SECTIONSOLIDS
commands.summary: Cuts 3D solids with a vertical section plane (two points) and places the 2D section (cut poché + projection) as a block; Plan cuts them horizontally.

commands.name: SECTIONSYMBOL
commands.summary: Draws a 2D section symbol: cut line with section heads (number / sheet attributes) looking to the picked side.

commands.name: SEISO
commands.summary: Sets the 3D view to seiso.

commands.name: SELECT
commands.summary: Selects objects and keeps them as the current selection.

commands.name: SELECTALL
commands.summary: Selects all selectable objects on unlocked layers (current level).

commands.name: SELECTCHAIN
commands.summary: Selects the chain (contour) of curves connected end-to-end with the picked one.

commands.name: SELECTINSTANCES
commands.summary: Selects every instance of the same block, opening type, wall type or element type as the picked object.

commands.name: SELECTINTERSECTING
commands.summary: Selects every object that intersects the picked one.

commands.name: SELECTINVERT
commands.summary: Inverts the selection (selects every other selectable object).

commands.name: SELECTIONINFO
commands.summary: Selection info panel: count and types of the selected objects, layers, total length/area, keep-only/remove filters.

commands.name: SELECTLAYER
commands.summary: Selects every object on the given layer(s) (wildcards allowed) or on the layer of a picked object.

commands.name: SELECTPREVIOUS
commands.summary: Selects the previous selection set again (only objects still selectable).

commands.name: SELECTSIMILAR
commands.summary: Selects all objects similar to the selected ones (type, plus the properties in SELECTSIMILARMODE).

commands.name: SELECTSIMILARMODE
commands.summary: System variable SELECTSIMILARMODE.

commands.name: SELECTTYPE
commands.summary: Selects objects by type or category (Line, Circle, Text, Annotation, Curve, Wall, Door, Element…); several types separated by commas.

commands.name: SELECTWALLCHAIN
commands.summary: Selects the chain of walls joined to a picked wall (Tab over a wall does the same).

commands.name: SELSET
commands.summary: Saves, restores, lists and deletes named selection sets (stored in the drawing).

commands.name: SEPARATE
commands.summary: Separates solids into their disjoint bodies and cleans them (duplicate/degenerate faces, consistent outward orientation).

commands.name: SETBYLAYER
commands.summary: Sets color, linetype and lineweight of objects (and block contents) to ByLayer.

commands.name: SETPROP
commands.summary: Sets any property of objects: SETPROP #12 height 2800.

commands.name: SETVAR
commands.summary: Lists or changes system variables.

commands.name: SHADEPLOT
commands.summary: Shade plot of a 3D (axonometric / perspective) sheet viewport: As Displayed, Wireframe, Hidden or Rendered, and the saved 3D view it shows.

commands.name: SHADOWDIAGRAM
commands.summary: Shadow study for a date and times at the project location: hatched ground shadows per time on A-SHADOW-hhmm layers and/or an SVG image sequence with an animated HTML page; prints the shadow areas.

commands.name: SHAFT
commands.summary: Creates a shaft that cuts every floor and roof between a base and a top level (associative: move it and the holes follow).

commands.name: SHAPEBINDER
commands.summary: Sub-shape binder: an associative copy of another body (Solid) or of one of its faces (Face, as a surface), optionally displaced; it follows the source when that changes.

commands.name: SHARE
commands.summary: Shares the drawing through the Windows share sheet (Mail, Teams, Nearby Sharing…): Project (.archi), Pdf of the drawing or active sheet, or Both.

commands.name: SHAREVIEW
commands.summary: Exports a read-only, self-contained HTML viewer (all level plans as vectors with pan/zoom, element info on click, room schedule, layer toggles) to share with people without the app.

commands.name: SHEETFIELD
commands.summary: Custom title block fields: Project fields appear on every sheet, Sheet fields override them on one sheet.

commands.name: SHEETGRID
commands.summary: Guide grid on the current sheet (spacing in paper mm, 0 = off); viewports snap to it when moved.

commands.name: SHEETIMAGE
commands.summary: Exports a sheet (layout) or the Model view of the current level as a PNG, JPEG or TIFF image at a chosen resolution (dpi).

commands.name: SHEETINDEX
commands.summary: Places or refreshes the sheet list table (number, title, paper, revision) on the active sheet.

commands.name: SHEETPLACEHOLDER
commands.summary: Adds a placeholder sheet (listed in the sheet set and index, never plotted) or toggles the current one.

commands.name: SHEETRENUMBER
commands.summary: Numbers all sheets in order with a prefix and start number (e.g. A- 101).

commands.name: SHEETREVISION
commands.summary: Adds a revision (next code, date, description, by) to the active sheet's revision table.

commands.name: SHEETSET
commands.summary: Sheet set manager: numbering, order, duplicate, revisions, sheet index.

commands.name: SHEETSVG
commands.summary: Exports the current sheet (or All sheets) as true-size vector SVG with one layer per drawing layer.

commands.name: SHEETVIEWTITLES
commands.summary: Editable view titles (number bubble, title, scale) under every viewport of the active sheet; keeps edited titles.

commands.name: SHELL
commands.summary: Hollows boxes and extrusions to a wall thickness, optionally removing the top face (SOLIDEDIT Shell).

commands.name: SHOW2D
commands.summary: Shows the 2D plan view.

commands.name: SHOW3D
commands.summary: Shows the 3D model view.

commands.name: SHPIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports an ESRI shapefile (.shp with .dbf attributes and .prj CRS: WGS84, UTM, Web Mercator) as points/polylines; elevation attributes become contour elevations.

commands.name: SIGNFILE
commands.summary: Signs a file (PDF, DWG, IFC, the drawing…) with your key: writes a detached <file>.sig with the signer, time, SHA-256 and Ed25519 signature.

commands.name: SIGNKEY
commands.summary: Creates (or shows) your Ed25519 signing key, kept in Application Support; prints the public key others add to TRUSTEDSIGNERS.

commands.name: SITEPATH
commands.summary: Draws a path of a given width along points as a site sub-region (draped on the toposurface).

commands.name: SKETCH
commands.summary: Freehand sketch: records the points of a drag (record increment, Type polyline/line/spline) until Enter.

commands.name: SKETCHPAD
commands.summary: Pads a sketch: its closed profile (with holes) extruded along the work-plane normal; the solid follows every change of the sketch.

commands.name: SKETCHPLANE
commands.summary: Sketch environment: New sketch on a work plane (XY at an elevation, a solid Face, or vertical through a Line), Add objects drawn in sketch coordinates, Status (degrees of freedom — constrain with the geometric/dimensional constraints), List, Delete.

commands.name: SKETCHTOWALLS
commands.summary: Converts a scanned or photographed plan image (PNG/BMP/PGM) into walls: dark strokes within a thickness range become wall centre lines at a given scale; asks for confirmation before creating them (one undo step).

commands.name: SKYLIGHT
commands.summary: Places a skylight / roof window in a roof: framed glazing in the roof plane that cuts the roof.

commands.name: SLAB
commands.summary: Creates a floor slab from points, a closed object or the walls around a point.

commands.name: SLABEDGE
commands.summary: Slab edges: an Upstand (curb, balcony upstand) or Fascia profile along a picked slab edge or All edges; Clear removes them.

commands.name: SLABOPENING
commands.summary: Cuts a vertical opening in one floor or roof (sketched outline; associative with its host).

commands.name: SLABSLOPE
commands.summary: Slopes a slab by a slope arrow (low point, high point, rise) or angle; Flat resets.

commands.name: SLABTYPE
commands.summary: Layered floor/roof types: list, create (plies top-down), assign to slabs and roofs (thickness follows the build-up), or delete.

commands.name: SLICE
commands.summary: Cuts solids with a vertical plane through two points or a horizontal plane (XY) at a height.

commands.name: SNAKE
commands.summary: Draws a polyline from relative moves: R500 L200 U300 D100 (right/left/up/down), @dx,dy or @d<angle; Close/Undo.

commands.name: SNAP
commands.summary: Turns grid snap on/off or sets the snap spacing (F9).

commands.name: SNAPMODE
commands.summary: System variable SNAPMODE.

commands.name: SNAPUNIT
commands.summary: System variable SNAPUNIT.

commands.name: SOFTEN
commands.summary: Softens and smooths the edges of solids/meshes whose faces meet at less than an angle (0 = sharp again); display only.

commands.name: SOLARRADIATION
commands.summary: Clear-sky solar irradiation (kWh/m² per day) on exterior walls, windows and roofs for a date at the project location; optional CSV.

commands.name: SOLID
commands.summary: Creates solid-filled triangles and quadrilaterals (AutoCAD point order 1-2-3-4).

commands.name: SOLIDCHECK
commands.summary: Validates solids: open or non-manifold edges, inconsistent orientation, degenerate faces, volume and bodies.

commands.name: SOLIDEDIT
commands.summary: Edits solid faces: Extrude, Move, Offset, Taper or Copy a face (picked Top/Bottom/Side in plan); Body Offset or Separate.

commands.name: SOLIDHIST
commands.summary: Turns recording of the CSG feature history of solids on or off (booleans on solids with a history always record).

commands.name: SOLIDHISTORY
commands.summary: Feature list of a solid: list, suppress/unsuppress, delete or move a boolean feature (the solid regenerates), or flatten the history.

commands.name: SPACEMOUSE
commands.summary: 3Dconnexion SpaceMouse: On/Off, Object (orbit) or Fly mode, Sensitivity, Status. Axes move the 3D camera; button 1 fits the view.

commands.name: SPEAKDRAWING
commands.summary: Describes the drawing, the selection and the current prompt (spoken by Narrator / Windows speech, printed on the command line).

commands.name: SPELL
commands.summary: Checks the spelling of text, leaders, tables, dimension text and attributes (Change / Ignore / Add to the drawing dictionary).

commands.name: SPELLDIALOG
commands.summary: Spelling dialog: lists misspelled words in text, leaders, tables and attributes with suggestions (Change / Ignore / Add).

commands.name: SPHERE
commands.summary: Creates a 3D solid sphere.

commands.name: SPLINE
commands.summary: Draws a smooth curve through fit points, or by control vertices (Method CV, Degree 1-5).

commands.name: SPLINEDIT
commands.summary: Edits splines: Close/Open, Fit data (Add/Delete/Move), control vertices, Convert to CV form or Polyline, Reverse, Undo.

commands.name: SPLIT
commands.summary: Shows the plan and 3D views side by side.

commands.name: SPLITSOLID
commands.summary: Splits solids by other solids into the parts inside and outside the tools (separate bodies).

commands.name: SPLITWALL
commands.summary: Splits a wall at a picked point (repeatable) or by Levels into one wall per storey; hosted openings follow their piece.

commands.name: SPOTCOORD
commands.summary: Labels the coordinates (N/E) of a point with a leader that updates when it is moved.

commands.name: SPOTELEV
commands.summary: Places live spot elevations (slab tops, roofs, toposurface) with a leader.

commands.name: SPOTSLOPE
commands.summary: Places live spot slopes (arrow pointing downhill with % and 1:n) on sloped slabs, ramps, roofs and toposurfaces.

commands.name: SPRING
commands.summary: Creates a helical coil spring solid (coil radius, wire radius, pitch, turns).

commands.name: STACKEDWALL
commands.summary: Makes walls stacked walls: segments of wall types bottom-up ("Type:height; Type:*"), regenerated when the base wall changes; Off removes the stack.

commands.name: STAIR
commands.summary: Creates straight, L, U or spiral stairs between levels (width, rise or top level, risers, tread, landings).

commands.name: STAIRCHECK
commands.summary: Checks stairs against riser, going, 2R+G, width, flight-length and landing rules.

commands.name: STAIRSKETCH
commands.summary: Stair by sketch: select riser lines (bottom to top by the walking line), give the total rise; the riser/going rules are checked (max riser, min going, 2R+G).

commands.name: STAIRTYPE
commands.summary: Stair types (max riser, min going, width, landing, material, railing type): New / Edit (every stair of the type follows), Assign to stairs, List, Delete.

commands.name: STANDARDS
commands.summary: Office standards package (.archistd): Export this drawing's layers, linetypes, styles, materials, types, view templates and hatch patterns; Import (add, optionally overwrite); Check deviations.

commands.name: STANDARDSCHECK
commands.summary: Checks layers (naming pattern, required layers, objects on layer 0), ByLayer properties, text heights/styles and linetypes against a JSON drawing standard (DRAWINGSTANDARDS variable or a file); lists, selects and zooms.

commands.name: STAR
commands.summary: Draws a star-shaped closed polyline.

commands.name: STARTSCREEN
commands.summary: Shows the start screen: templates, samples and recent drawings.

commands.name: STATUS
commands.summary: Displays drawing statistics, modes and extents.

commands.name: STEELCONNECTION
commands.summary: Steel connections sized from the member section: Base plate with anchor bolts or Cap plate on a column, End plate with bolts on a beam end; they follow the member.

commands.name: STEELPROFILE
commands.summary: Applies structural profiles (IPE, HEA, HEB, UPN, I/H/C/L/T, RHS/SHS/CHS, rectangular, round) to beams and columns, or lists them.

commands.name: STEPIN
commands.summary: Imports polyhedral geometry from a STEP (AP203/AP214/AP242) file as mesh solids (planar faces; curved B-rep surfaces are skipped).

commands.name: STEPOUT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as STEP AP214 faceted B-reps (one solid per element, millimetres, with colours).

commands.name: STEREOPANORAMA
commands.summary: Stereo 360° panorama for VR viewers: left and right eye equirectangular images over-under (omni-directional stereo), from the 3D camera or a plan point.

commands.name: STOREFRONT
commands.summary: Storefront curtain walls (bays, transom, capped mullions, entrance door) or glazed Partitions (slim mullions, full-height door).

commands.name: STORY
commands.summary: Storey settings: Height (moves the storeys above), Insert above / below, Delete, Computation height (walls that bound rooms), Elevation display (project / survey / relative), List.

commands.name: STRETCH
commands.summary: Stretches objects crossed by a window; objects fully inside are moved.

commands.name: STRUCTCOLUMN
commands.summary: Places structural columns with a profile (HEA/IPE/RHS/CHS… or RECT / ROUND concrete), from the level to the next level (or a height), at points or at every grid intersection.

commands.name: STRUCTLOAD
commands.summary: Adds a structural load on layer S-LOADS for the analytical model: Point (kN at a node or on a beam), Line (kN/m along beams) or Area (kN/m² over an outline); vertical downward by default, optional horizontal components and load case.

commands.name: STRUCTSUPPORT
commands.summary: Adds a support (boundary condition) for the analytical model at a node: Fixed, Pinned, Roller or a custom ux uy uz rx ry rz code (e.g. 111000).

commands.name: STRUCTURAL
commands.summary: Structural usage of walls, slabs, columns and beams: Bearing, Shear, Combined or Non-bearing (drives the analytical model and schedules).

commands.name: SUBOBJECT
commands.summary: Sub-object editing (Ctrl-click in the viewport): pick a Face, Edge or Vertex of a solid and Move it, Extrude a face, or list Info.

commands.name: SUBREGION
commands.summary: Creates a site sub-region (lawn, gravel, paving) from points or a closed object, draped on the toposurface.

commands.name: SUBTRACT
commands.summary: Subtracts solids from other solids.

commands.name: SUNPATH
commands.summary: Draws a polar sun path diagram (altitude rings, compass, the day's path with hours, solstices/equinox) for a date at the project location.

commands.name: SUNPOSITION
commands.summary: Sun azimuth/altitude, sunrise and sunset for a date, time and the project location; stores SUNAZIMUTH/SUNALTITUDE.

commands.name: SUNSTUDY
commands.summary: Sun study panel in the 3D view: date and time sliders with a day animation.

commands.name: SUNSTUDYVIDEO
commands.summary: Exports an MP4 sun-study time-lapse (shadows through the day) from the current 3D camera.

commands.name: SURFANALYSIS
commands.summary: Surface analysis: Zebra stripes, Curvature (Gaussian or mean, colour bands), Draft angle against a pull direction, Continuity between two surfaces, or Clear the analysis overlays.

commands.name: SURFBLEND
commands.summary: Blend surface between the edges of two surfaces with G0 (position), G1 (tangent) or G2 (curvature) continuity and a bulge factor.

commands.name: SURFCV
commands.summary: B-spline (NURBS) surface from a grid of control vertices: New over a rectangle, Edit moves a CV (row, column, height), Display the CV grid.

commands.name: SURFEXTEND
commands.summary: Extends the outer edges of surfaces tangentially by a distance.

commands.name: SURFNETWORK
commands.summary: Network surface through curves in the U and V directions (Gordon surface: passes through every curve).

commands.name: SURFOFFSET
commands.summary: Offset copy of surfaces along their normals.

commands.name: SURFPATCH
commands.summary: Patch surface filling a closed boundary (one closed curve or curves meeting end to end; 3D polylines with vertexZ or elevations): planar boundaries exactly, others as a Coons patch.

commands.name: SURFSCULPT
commands.summary: Joins surfaces that enclose a watertight volume into a solid (the surfaces are replaced).

commands.name: SURFTRIM
commands.summary: Trims surfaces with a closed plan curve (projected vertically), keeping the part Inside or Outside.

commands.name: SURVEYLINES
commands.summary: Survey field-to-finish: joins survey points into polylines by their codes (EP1 B … EP1 E, C to close) and moves points to the feature layers of the description keys (variable SURVEYCODES: EP=V-ROAD-EDGE:line; TREE=V-TREE:point).

commands.name: SURVEYPOINT
commands.summary: Places the survey point: a location and its shared coordinates (the base point's shared coordinates follow).

commands.name: SVGIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports SVG paths, lines, polylines, polygons, circles, ellipses, rectangles and text as drawing entities.

commands.name: SVGLAYERSOUT
commands.summary: Exports the current level's plan as SVG with one group (Inkscape/Illustrator layer) per drawing layer.

commands.name: SWEEP
commands.summary: Sweeps closed profiles along a path (profile X to the left of travel, Y up).

commands.name: SWEEP3D
commands.summary: Sweeps a closed profile (centred on the path) along a 3D path such as a helix (or a new Helix); associative with profile and path.

commands.name: SYSVARMONITOR
commands.summary: Watch list of system variables: you are notified when a command changes one of them.

commands.name: SYSWINDOWS
commands.summary: Arranges the open drawing windows: Vertical (side by side), Horizontal, Cascade, Tabs or Separate windows.

commands.name: TABLE
commands.summary: Inserts an empty table.

commands.name: TABLEEDIT
commands.summary: Edits a table: cell text or =formula (SUM, AVERAGE…), insert/delete rows and columns, column widths.

commands.name: TABLEEXPORT
commands.summary: Exports a table to a CSV file.

commands.name: TABLELINK
commands.summary: Inserts a table linked to a CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file (update with DATALINKUPDATE when the file changes).

commands.name: TABLESTYLE
commands.summary: Table styles: New / Edit title, header and data cells (height, alignment, colour, fill), Current, Apply to tables, List, Delete.

commands.name: TABSURF
commands.summary: Tabulated mesh surface: sweeps a path curve along a direction vector (a line) or straight up by a height.

commands.name: TAG
commands.summary: Tags a door, window, room or element with a live label (mark, type, name, area, keynote…).

commands.name: TAGALL
commands.summary: Tags every untagged door, window and/or room on the current level.

commands.name: TAGLABEL
commands.summary: Tag labels linked to element parameters: Label template with {Parameter} fields, single Field, Annotative paper height, List.

commands.name: TAKEOFF
commands.summary: Quantity takeoff: wall areas/volumes (net of openings) per type and material, slabs, roofs, columns, beams, door/window counts; optional CSV.

commands.name: TAKEOFFPHASE
commands.summary: Quantity takeoff split by construction phase (new work and demolition) and level; optional CSV.

commands.name: TAPEMEASURE
commands.summary: Tape measure: Measure between two points, create a Guide parallel to an edge at a distance or through a point, or a Protractor guide at an angle.

commands.name: TEMPHIDE
commands.summary: Temporarily hides the selected elements, or a whole Category (wall, door, component…) on the current level; UNISOLATEOBJECTS or REVEALHIDDEN Unhide restores them.

commands.name: TEMPISOLATE
commands.summary: Temporarily isolates element categories on the current level: every other category is hidden until UNISOLATEOBJECTS.

commands.name: TEMPLATEIN
commands.summary: Replaces the drawing with a new untitled drawing started from a template file (undoable).

commands.name: TEMPLATEOUT
commands.summary: Writes the drawing as a template file (.architemplate) with a name and description; everything in the drawing is kept.

commands.name: TEXT
commands.summary: Creates single-line text objects.

commands.name: TEXT3D
commands.summary: Creates extruded 3D text (single-line font strokes as solid bars).

commands.name: TEXTEDIT
commands.summary: Edits text, leader, dimension text, table cells or attribute values.

commands.name: TEXTEDITINPLACE
commands.summary: In-place text editor on the canvas: bold, italic, underline, font, height and colour (also opened by double-clicking text); exported to PDF and DXF MTEXT.

commands.name: TEXTFRAME
commands.summary: Draws or removes a frame around text.

commands.name: TEXTLAYER
commands.summary: System variable TEXTLAYER.

commands.name: TEXTLIST
commands.summary: Adds bullets, numbers or letters to the paragraphs of multiline text (or removes them).

commands.name: TEXTMASK
commands.summary: Hides objects behind text with a background mask (offset factor, background or a colour).

commands.name: TEXTREADABLE
commands.summary: Turns upside-down text (rotated between 90° and 270°) by 180° so it reads left-to-right, keeping its position.

commands.name: TEXTSIZE
commands.summary: System variable TEXTSIZE.

commands.name: TEXTSTYLE
commands.summary: Creates or modifies a text style and makes it current.

commands.name: TEXTSTYLEDIALOG
commands.summary: Text Style manager: font, height, width factor and oblique angle with a live preview; renaming a style updates its text.

commands.name: TEXTTOFRONT
commands.summary: Brings text, dimensions and/or leaders in front of other objects (options: Text/Dimensions/Leaders/All).

commands.name: TEXTUNMASK
commands.summary: Removes background masks from text.

commands.name: THEME
commands.summary: Switches the interface theme [Dark/Light].

commands.name: THERMALBRIDGES
commands.summary: Finds geometric linear thermal bridges of the envelope (wall corners, ground and intermediate floor edges, balconies, eaves, window/door reveals, columns in exterior walls) with lengths, ψ values (PSI:<kind> overrides) and H_TB = Σψ·L; selects the elements.

commands.name: THICKEN
commands.summary: Turns surfaces into solids by offsetting them along their normals (negative = other side).

commands.name: TILEDVIEWS
commands.summary: Tiled model views: 2, 3 or 4 views (plan, 3D, section, elevations), each with its own zoom and pan.

commands.name: TIME
commands.summary: Shows the drawing's creation and last-update dates, total editing time (idle gaps over 5 minutes excluded) and the user elapsed timer; ON/OFF/Reset control the timer.

commands.name: TITLEBLOCK
commands.summary: Edits the active sheet's title block and the project information shown on all sheets.

commands.name: TITLEBLOCKDESIGN
commands.summary: Custom title blocks: Create a starter block (edit it with BEDIT: lines, logo images, {field} texts or attributes), Use a block on all or the current sheet, or go back to the Builtin one.

commands.name: TLEN
commands.summary: Total length of the selected lines, arcs, circles, polylines, splines and ellipses (and wall lengths).

commands.name: TOLERANCE
commands.summary: Creates a GD&T feature control frame: characteristic symbol, tolerance value, datums.

commands.name: TOOLPALETTES
commands.summary: Shows the tool palettes panel (grouped tools and My Tools).

commands.name: TOOLPALETTESCLOSE
commands.summary: Hides the tool palettes panel.

commands.name: TOPO
commands.summary: Creates a toposurface from points (with elevations), contour polylines (picked, or every object on contour Layers of an imported DXF), an XYZ/CSV file or typed x,y,z values.

commands.name: TOPVIEW
commands.summary: Sets the 3D view to top.

commands.name: TORUS
commands.summary: Creates a torus: centre, radius of the torus, radius of the tube.

commands.name: TRACE
commands.summary: Draws solid lines of a given width (a wide polyline).

commands.name: TRACEREVIEW
commands.summary: Trace review overlays: New (named overlay layer over the drawing, linked to the view and selected elements), Enter/Exit (draw on it), Show/Hide, Zoom (restores its view and selects its elements), List, Close, Import (merge its sketches into the drawing), Delete.

commands.name: TRANSFERSTANDARDS
commands.summary: Copies types, styles and settings (wall/slab/opening/stair/railing types, materials, layers, linetypes, text and dimension styles, view templates, families, parameters, schedules, keynotes) from another .archi file.

commands.name: TRANSPARENCYDISPLAY
commands.summary: System variable TRANSPARENCYDISPLAY.

commands.name: TRIM
commands.summary: Trims objects at cutting edges (all objects are cutting edges by default).

commands.name: TRIMMODE
commands.summary: System variable TRIMMODE.

commands.name: TRUENORTH
commands.summary: Sets true north relative to project north (angle counter-clockwise from up, or Align to a picked direction).

commands.name: TRUSS
commands.summary: Places a Pratt, Howe, Warren or Fink truss between two bearing points (height, member width, bearing elevation).

commands.name: TRUSTSIGNER
commands.summary: Adds a signer's public key (or the key of a .sig file) to the drawing's trusted signers.

commands.name: TUTORIALRECORD
commands.summary: Tutorial videos: List the scripted tutorials, Check them, or Record (the videos are recorded by the Mac app; on Windows Record opens the tutorial videos on the website).

commands.name: TUTORIALS
commands.summary: Opens the step-by-step tutorials and the sample project in the help browser.

commands.name: TWOPOINT
commands.summary: Two-point perspective: levels the 3D camera so vertical lines stay vertical, shifting the lens to keep the framing (On/Off).

commands.name: TXT2MTXT
commands.summary: Combines single-line texts into one multiline text (top to bottom).

commands.name: TXTEXP
commands.summary: Explodes text into line geometry drawn with the built-in stroke font (or [Letters]: single-letter text objects).

commands.name: TYPEIMAGE
commands.summary: Assigns an image file to a type (wall/opening/family type); schedules with an Image field show it in placed tables.

commands.name: U
commands.summary: Reverses the most recent action.

commands.name: UCS
commands.summary: Sets the user coordinate system: World, Origin, Z rotation, 3point, Object, Previous, Named save/restore.

commands.name: UCSICON
commands.summary: Controls the UCS icon: ON, OFF, Noorigin (lower-left corner) or ORigin (at the UCS origin when visible).

commands.name: UCSMAN
commands.summary: Named UCS manager: lists the saved user coordinate systems and restores, saves, renames or deletes them (World and Previous too).

commands.name: UNDERLAY
commands.summary: Shows another level halftone under the current plan (None to turn off).

commands.name: UNDO
commands.summary: Reverses actions: a count, or Mark/Back (to a mark) and BEgin/End (group several commands into one step).

commands.name: UNFOLD
commands.summary: Unfolds a solid or mesh into a flat net for fabrication (cut lines solid, fold lines dashed), placed at a point.

commands.name: UNGROUP
commands.summary: Dissolves the groups of the selected objects.

commands.name: UNION
commands.summary: Combines selected 3D solids into one.

commands.name: UNISOLATEOBJECTS
commands.summary: Shows all objects hidden by HIDEOBJECTS or ISOLATEOBJECTS.

commands.name: UNITPRICE
commands.summary: Stores a unit rate in the drawing (COST:<category>[:<type>]:<measure>) used by COSTESTIMATE.

commands.name: UNITS
commands.summary: Sets drawing units (mm, cm, m, in, ft) and optionally scales the drawing.

commands.name: UPDATEFIELD
commands.summary: Updates fields (including date fields) in the selected text.

commands.name: UPGRADEFILE
commands.summary: Upgrades older .archi / .architemplate files (a file or every file in a folder) to the current format, keeping the originals as .vN.archi.bak.

commands.name: USDEXPORT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as USD: .usda text or .usdz package (UsdPreviewSurface materials).

commands.name: UVALUE
commands.summary: U-value (EN ISO 6946) of selected walls, slabs, roofs and openings from their layers; Lambda sets a material's conductivity, Set a type's U-value.

commands.name: VERIFYSIGNATURE
commands.summary: Checks a file against its <file>.sig: valid signature, unchanged content, and whether the signer is trusted (TRUSTEDSIGNERS).

commands.name: VERSIONS
commands.summary: Version history saved next to the drawing: Save a named checkpoint, List, Restore a version (undoable), Diff two versions (or a version and the current drawing), Delete, Prune.

commands.name: VIEW
commands.summary: Saves, restores, lists and deletes named views.

commands.name: VIEWCROP
commands.summary: Crop region of the current project view: Window, Polygon, On, Off, Annotation crop offset, Show / Hide the crop boundary.

commands.name: VIEWDRAW
commands.summary: Places an elevation or section of the model as a 2D drawing (with level heads and grid bubbles) in model space.

commands.name: VIEWGRAPHICS
commands.summary: View graphics: Categories (visibility/graphics overrides per category), Filters (rule-based view filters), Detail level, and Section/elevation graphics (line weights by depth, hidden lines, depth cueing, far clip, dimensions).

commands.name: VIEWIMAGE
commands.summary: Saves the 3D view as a PNG, JPEG or TIFF at a chosen size, optionally with a transparent background.

commands.name: VIEWRANGE
commands.summary: Plan view range relative to the level: Top, Cut plane, Bottom and View depth; elements above the top are left out and those below the bottom (down to the view depth, also from lower levels) are drawn as beyond. Off restores the default.

commands.name: VIEWSECTIONBOX
commands.summary: Section box of the current 3D view: Fit (selection, level or model), Box (two corners and heights), On, Off.

commands.name: VIEWTEMPLATE
commands.summary: View templates: list, apply to the current view, capture the current settings as a template, set a template value, apply to a placed drawing view, or delete.

commands.name: VIEWTITLE
commands.summary: Adds or refreshes view titles (number bubble, name, scale) under every viewport of a sheet.

commands.name: VIEWUPDATE
commands.summary: Regenerates all placed elevation/section drawing views from the current model.

commands.name: VISUALSTYLES
commands.summary: Visual styles manager: New/Edit a custom style from a base (edges, edge colour, face opacity, shadows, background), Delete, List, Current.

commands.name: VPCLIP
commands.summary: Clips a sheet viewport to a polygon of paper points (x,y in mm), or Deletes the clip.

commands.name: VPLAYER
commands.summary: Freezes/thaws layers in individual sheet viewports: Freeze, Thaw, Reset, List (layout and viewport numbers or All).

commands.name: VPLOCK
commands.summary: Locks or unlocks sheet viewports so their scale and position cannot change.

commands.name: VPMAX
commands.summary: Maximises a sheet viewport: edits the model through it at full window size (VPMIN returns).

commands.name: VPMIN
commands.summary: Returns from a maximised viewport to its sheet, keeping the new view centre (unless the viewport is locked).

commands.name: VRVIEW
commands.summary: VR headset viewing: writes the model as a WebXR page (life-size, floor on the room floor, pinch/trigger steps forward) for Apple Vision Pro, Meta Quest or OpenXR browsers; Open, Reveal (AirDrop) or just Save.

commands.name: VSCURRENT
commands.summary: Sets the visual style of the 3D view.

commands.name: WALK
commands.summary: Starts a first-person walkthrough of the 3D model.

commands.name: WALKTHROUGHVIDEO
commands.summary: Exports an MP4 walkthrough along a smooth path through the saved cameras (in order).

commands.name: WALL
commands.summary: Draws a chain of joined walls (thickness, height, justification, type, arcs).

commands.name: WALLATTACH
commands.summary: Attaches the top of walls to a roof or slab soffit, or the base to a slab top; Detach removes the attachment.

commands.name: WALLBYLINES
commands.summary: Converts selected lines, arcs, polylines, splines and ellipses into walls (curves become chains of arc walls).

commands.name: WALLFLIP
commands.summary: Flips walls: swaps the interior and exterior faces (layer order) keeping the wall, its openings and door swings in place.

commands.name: WALLHEIGHT
commands.summary: System variable WALLHEIGHT.

commands.name: WALLJOIN
commands.summary: Joins wall ends that nearly meet (extends/trims them to their intersection).

commands.name: WALLJOINEDIT
commands.summary: Edits a wall join: pick near a wall end, then Miter, Butt (this wall stops at the other), Square off, or Disallow the join.

commands.name: WALLPOLYGON
commands.summary: Draws a closed loop of joined walls: a regular polygon (centre, sides, radius), points, or a picked closed polyline.

commands.name: WALLRECT
commands.summary: Draws four joined walls around a rectangle (two corners; Justify sets whether the rectangle is the inside, centre or outside face).

commands.name: WALLSWEEP
commands.summary: Adds cornices, skirting boards or string courses along wall faces, Reveals (grooves cut into the faces), or removes them.

commands.name: WALLTHICKNESS
commands.summary: System variable WALLTHICKNESS.

commands.name: WALLTOP
commands.summary: Sets the top constraint of walls (a level with offset, the next level, or an unconnected height) and their shape: elevation Profile or Gable, Slant, Taper, Reset.

commands.name: WALLWRAP
commands.summary: Wraps the finish layers of compound walls into door/window openings (all walls or selected walls) and around free wall Ends.

commands.name: WATER
commands.summary: Water surface with animated waves (viewport and renders) inside a closed polyline or picked points, at a surface elevation and depth.

commands.name: WBLOCK
commands.summary: Writes a block, selected objects or the whole drawing to a new .archi file.

commands.name: WEATHER
commands.summary: Weather in the 3D view and renders: Clear, Rain, Snow or Fog with an intensity, snow cover on up-facing faces and wet surfaces.

commands.name: WEBVIEWEREXPORT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as one standalone HTML file with a WebGL viewer (orbit, pan, zoom, views) that opens in any browser.

commands.name: WEDGE
commands.summary: Creates a wedge solid: base rectangle by two corners (or Length), height; the top slopes down along X.

commands.name: WELD
commands.summary: Merges curves touching end to end (lines, arcs, polylines, splines, ellipse arcs) into polylines.

commands.name: WHATSNEW
commands.summary: Shows what is new in this version (also shown once after an update).

commands.name: WINDOW
commands.summary: Places windows in walls (default 1200×1200, sill 900).

commands.name: WINDOWTABS
commands.summary: Window tabs: Merge all drawing windows into tabs, or open new drawings in Tabs / Windows.

commands.name: WINDRESULTS
commands.summary: Imports an OpenFOAM pedestrian-level velocity sample (raw x y z Ux Uy Uz) as wind arrows coloured by speed with Lawson comfort classes (the case's wind direction is taken from WINDDIRECTION); the Solve option runs the built-in 2D lattice Boltzmann solver instead (no external CFD needed).

commands.name: WIPEOUT
commands.summary: Creates a masking area (solid background fill) that covers objects beneath.

commands.name: WIREFRAME
commands.summary: Wireframe modifier: turns the edges of a solid or mesh into struts of a given thickness (Solidify: THICKEN).

commands.name: WORKSCHEDULE
commands.summary: Construction sequencing (4D) and resources: Generate tasks from the model (by level and trade, quantity-based durations, crews), List with dates and critical path, Duration/Link to edit tasks, Simulate a date (selects the elements built by then), Resources (histogram, over-allocation, cost), Level (resource levelling), Gantt (SVG), Csv.

commands.name: WORKSET
commands.summary: Worksets (named element sets): list, new, current, assign selection, hide/show, select members.

commands.name: WSCURRENT
commands.summary: Switches workspace (panels, views and ribbon tab), e.g. WSCURRENT 3D Modeling.

commands.name: WSSAVE
commands.summary: Saves the current window arrangement as a named workspace.

commands.name: XATTACH
commands.summary: Attaches a drawing (.archi/.dxf) as an external reference and places it.

commands.name: XBIND
commands.summary: Binds external references into the drawing as ordinary blocks (Bind: X$0$name, Insert: merged names).

commands.name: XCLIP
commands.summary: Clips block references and xrefs to a rectangular or polygonal boundary (New/ON/OFF/Delete/Polyline).

commands.name: XLINE
commands.summary: Draws infinite construction lines: through two points, Horizontal, Vertical, at an Angle (or relative to a Reference line), Bisecting an angle, or Offset from a line.

commands.name: XLSXIN
commands.summary: Places the sheets of an .xlsx workbook as table entities.

commands.name: XLSXOUT
commands.summary: Writes the schedules (walls, doors, windows, rooms, slabs, takeoff, areas by level) to an Excel .xlsx workbook.

commands.name: XREF
commands.summary: External references: list, Attach/Overlay a drawing (.archi/.dxf), Reload, Unload, Detach, Bind, Path, Notify (changed files).

commands.name: ZONE
commands.summary: Zones: Assign rooms to a named fire/HVAC/department/security zone, Remove, List zone areas, or draw zone Outlines (rooms merged across the walls).

commands.name: ZOOM
commands.summary: Zooms: All/Extents, Window, Previous, Center, Object, or a scale (2, 0.5x).

commands.name: ZOOMXP
commands.summary: ZOOM nXP: in a sheet sets the selected viewport to 1:n (1/100XP); on the plan shows the drawing at that paper scale at true size on the screen.
